items.title: 黃仁勳身價一日暴增149億美元 超越祖克柏躍居全球第六
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Net Worth Jumps $14.9 B in One Day, Surpassing Zuckerberg to Rank Sixth Globally
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)股價周四(27日)上漲8.7%，此前公司公布第二季財報及財測。強勁的股價表現也推升了輝達執行長黃仁勳的身價。
黃仁勳曾在一家Denny"s餐廳內創辦輝達，並協助打造如今全球市值最高的公司。
輝達股價周四收於227.98美元，接近236.54美元的歷史新高。
根據《富比士》資料，隨著周四股價上漲，黃仁勳身價估計增加149億美元，按美元計算，成為當天所有億萬富豪中身價增加最多的人。
這149億美元的增幅，使黃仁勳身價升至1,961億美元。這位持有這家半導體巨頭約3%股份的創辦人兼執行長，身價單日大增8.2%。
隨著身價增加，黃仁勳在《富比士》億萬富豪榜上的排名升至第六名，身價達1,961億美元。周四，黃仁勳超越了祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)的1,956億美元與Larry Ellison的1,936億美元身價。祖克柏身價周四減少23億美元，而Ellison則增加24億美元。
排名在黃仁勳之前的是位居第五名的戴爾(Michael Dell)。戴爾是周四身價增加第二多的富豪，增加32億美元，使其總身價達2,434億美元。
如今黃仁勳的身價僅略高於祖克柏與Ellison，但仍落後戴爾超過450億美元，因此在再次向上攀升之前，他的排名更有可能跌出全球前十大富豪之列。
輝達股價飆升
輝達股價周四大漲，分析師與投資人正在消化公司第二季財報及財測。
輝達周三公布季度業績後，股價最初下跌，但公司的財報電話會議提供了更多供需細節，以及對2028財年的初步展望。
公司針對2028會計年度營收年增70%所提供的非正式財測，是許多分析師關注的亮點。如果不是受到供應限制，這項數字可能超過100%。這也促使分析師上調目標價，並開始期待這家半導體巨頭未來更多季度及年度的爆發式成長。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares rose 8.7% on Thursday the 27th after the company released its Q2 earnings and outlook, and the strong stock performance also boosted CEO Jensen Huang’s net worth.
Huang founded Nvidia in a Denny’s restaurant and helped build what is now the world’s most valuable company by market cap.
Nvidia’s stock closed Thursday at $227.98, near the historic high of $236.54.
According to Forbes, the Thursday price surge added roughly $14.9 billion to Huang’s wealth, making him the billionaire with the biggest single‑day gain that day.
The $14.9 billion increase lifted Huang’s net worth to $196.1 billion, a roughly 8.2% jump for the founder‑CEO who owns about 3% of the semiconductor giant.

With the higher net worth, Huang moved up to sixth place on Forbes’ billionaire list at $196.1 billion, overtaking Mark Zuckerberg’s $195.6 billion and Larry Ellison’s $193.6 billion; Zuckerberg’s wealth fell by $2.3 billion on Thursday while Ellison’s rose by $2.4 billion.
The only person ahead of Huang is Michael Dell, who ranked fifth and saw the second‑largest daily gain of $3.2 billion, bringing his total wealth to $243.4 billion.
Although Huang now edges slightly ahead of Zuckerberg and Ellison, he still trails Dell by more than $45 billion, so another rise could see his rank slip out of the global top ten.
Nvidia’s stock surge
Nvidia’s shares jumped sharply on Thursday as analysts and investors digested the company’s Q2 results and outlook.
After Nvidia reported its quarterly earnings on Wednesday, the stock initially fell, but the earnings call provided more supply‑demand details and an early outlook for fiscal 2028.

The informal guidance for fiscal 2028, which projects a 70% year‑over‑year revenue increase, was a key focus for many analysts; without supply constraints the figure could exceed 100%, prompting analysts to raise price targets and anticipate further explosive quarterly and annual growth from the semiconductor leader.

items.title: 華許傑克森霍爾首秀牽動美股 歷史數據透露哪些訊號？
items.title_en: Jerome Powell's Jackson Hole Debut Moves U.S. Stocks; Historical Data Shows What Signals?
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許週五 (28日) 將首次在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說。過去 3 年，標普 500 指數在 Fed 主席演說當天均上漲，但今年面臨通膨高於目標、美債殖利率攀升及政府債務膨脹等多重壓力，市場未必會再次給出正面反應。
數據顯示，自 2016 年以來的 10 次傑克森霍爾演說中，標普 500 有 70%的機率在當天上漲，一週後維持上漲的比率同樣為 70%；一個月後仍上漲的比率則降至 50%。
從平均報酬來看，演說當天標普 500 小跌 0.09%，一週後平均上漲 0.47%，一個月後平均下跌 0.55%。若改看中位數，三個期間則分別上漲 0.39%、0.54%及 0.22%，顯示市場多數時候反應溫和，但少數大跌年份明顯拖累整體平均表現。
2022年就是最鮮明的例子。時任 Fed 主席鮑爾當時以簡短而強硬的演說警告，為壓低通膨，企業與家庭可能必須承受經濟痛苦及就業損失。
標普 500 當天重挫 3.37%，一週後跌幅擴大至 3.29%，一個月後更累計下跌 9.92%，創近 10 年 Fed 主席傑克森霍爾演說後最差表現。
華許政策思路仍是謎
市場這次格外緊張，主要原因在於華爾街尚未摸清華許的政策思路。華許自 5 月接任 Fed 主席以來，主張央行應多聽取市場訊號、減少對外發言，並將通膨拉回 2%列為重要目標，卻未詳細說明具體路徑。
Columbia Threadneedle Investments首席投資組合策略師 Jason Vaillancourt表示，華許這場演說對市場影響重大，目前沒有人真正了解他制定政策時遵循的核心原則，也不確定他是否意識到市場迫切需要更明確的政策資訊。
華許不喜歡提供前瞻指引，發言風格也較為簡短，與鮑爾掌舵 Fed的8年形成明顯差異。標普 500 自兩週前創下歷史高點後走勢震盪，加上華許7月第二場記者會後美債遭到拋售，投資人擔心他的演說可能再度引發市場波動。
通膨、升息與債市三重壓力
目前 Fed主要通膨指標年增率達3.7%，仍遠高於2%目標。根據 CME FedWatch 工具，市場週四仍預期 Fed 9月會議維持利率不變，但對12月前升息一次的押注正在增加。
Fed如何讓通膨回落至2%的政策路徑仍不明朗，也是今年夏季美債賣壓升高的原因之一。30年期美債殖利率8月一度觸及2007年以來最高水準，10年期美債殖利率週四則徘徊在4.66%附近，雖略低於近期高點，仍明顯高於3月的約4%。
除了利率與通膨，華爾街也關注美國政府債務增至40兆美元，以及大型雲端業者為擴建AI基礎設施大量借款，對資金成本與債券供給造成的壓力。
隨著AI建設成為支撐美股的重要力量，債券殖利率上升也開始左右科技股及大盤走勢。
財政部與Fed會否互相牴觸？
財長貝森特計畫從9月起擴大回購長期美債，試圖改善債市狀況並降低借貸成本，但目前尚不清楚這項措施是否足以壓低殖利率。
Interactive Brokers首席策略師 Steve Sosnick表示，財政部的回購規模雖遠小於央行的債券購買計畫，仍可能對經濟產生刺激效果。在通膨尚未受控的情況下，這也引發財政部與Fed是否朝相反方向施力的疑問。
Sosnick預期，華許本次演說可能相當簡短，市場關心的許多問題未必能獲得答案。今年年會主題聚焦金融創新，華許也可能完全不談財政部近期介入債市的措施。對投資人而言，演說真正的風險可能不只是華許說了什麼，也包括他選擇不說什麼。
paras_en: Marketwatch reports that Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell will deliver his first speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting on Friday the 28th. Over the past three years, the S&P 500 has risen on the day of a Fed chair’s speech, but this year the market faces multiple pressures—inflation above target, rising U.S. Treasury yields and expanding government debt—so a positive reaction is not guaranteed.

Data show that in the ten Jackson Hole speeches since 2016, the S&P 500 has a 70% chance of gaining on the day of the speech, a 70% chance of staying up a week later, and a 50% chance of still being up a month later.

Looking at average returns, the S&P 500 fell 0.09% on speech day, rose an average of 0.47% a week later and slipped an average of 0.55% after a month. Using the median instead, the three periods show gains of 0.39%, 0.54% and 0.22% respectively, indicating that most of the time the market’s reaction is modest, but a few years with sharp drops pull down the overall average performance.
2022 is the clearest example. Then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell gave a brief but forceful warning that to bring inflation down, businesses and households might have to endure economic pain and job losses.
The S&P 500 plunged 3.37% that day, the loss widened to 3.29% a week later and deepened to a 9.92% decline after a month, the worst post‑Jackson Hole performance for a Fed chair in nearly a decade.
Powell’s policy direction remains a mystery

The market is especially nervous this time because Wall Street has not yet grasped Powell’s policy thinking. Since taking over in May, Powell has said the central bank should listen more to market signals, speak less publicly and make bringing inflation back to 2% a key goal, but he has not detailed the concrete path.

Jason Vaillancourt, chief portfolio strategist at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, said Powell’s speech will have a major market impact, yet no one truly understands the core principles he follows when setting policy, nor whether he realizes the market’s urgent need for clearer policy information.

Powell dislikes giving forward guidance and his speaking style is terse, a stark contrast to the eight years under former chair Jerome Powell. The S&P 500 has been choppy since hitting a historic high two weeks ago, and after Powell’s second press conference in July U.S. Treasuries were sold off, prompting investors to fear his speech could spark further market volatility.
Inflation, rate hikes and bond market pressure converge

Currently the Fed’s main inflation gauge is up 3.7% year‑over‑year, still well above the 2% target. According to the CME FedWatch tool, markets on Thursday still expect the Fed to hold rates steady at the September meeting, but bets on a rate hike before December are rising.

The policy path for bringing inflation back to 2% remains unclear, which is one reason summer U.S. bond‑selling pressure has intensified. The 30‑year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007 in August, while the 10‑year yield hovered around 4.66% on Thursday, slightly below recent peaks but still markedly above the roughly 4% seen in March.

Beyond rates and inflation, Wall Street is watching U.S. government debt swell to $40 trillion and large cloud providers borrowing heavily to expand AI infrastructure, adding pressure on funding costs and bond supply.
As AI construction becomes a key driver of U.S. equities, rising bond yields are also beginning to influence tech stocks and overall market direction.
Will the Treasury and the Fed clash?

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen plans to expand long‑term Treasury buybacks starting in September, aiming to improve bond market conditions and lower borrowing costs, though it is unclear whether the move will be enough to push yields down.

Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said that although the Treasury’s buyback scale is far smaller than the Fed’s bond‑purchase programs, it could still have a stimulative effect on the economy. With inflation still unchecked, this raises questions about whether the Treasury and the Fed are pulling in opposite directions.

Sosnick expects Powell’s speech to be fairly brief, and many of the market’s pressing questions may go unanswered. This year’s meeting focuses on financial innovation, and Powell may completely avoid discussing the Treasury’s recent bond‑market interventions. For investors, the real risk of the speech may lie not only in what Powell says, but also in what he chooses not to say.

items.title: 習近平訪美倒數 川普突暗示制裁「中國銀行」
items.title_en: Countdown to Xi Jinping's US Visit, Trump Hints at Sanctioning "Chinese Banks"
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美中官員正為中國國家主席習近平下月訪問華盛頓進行準備之際，美國總統川普週四 (27 日) 再度升高對北京的施壓力道，暗示不排除制裁協助伊朗石油交易的中國銀行。
川普週四向媒體表示，他「可能會制裁中國銀行」，並稱自己不必事先宣布所有措施。美國財長貝森特本週稍早也警告，若中國銀行參與將伊朗石油轉化為資金、進而支持伊朗政府的金融體系，就可能成為美方制裁目標。
儘管白宮對中措辭轉趨強硬，美中雙方仍持續推進高層互動。川普表示，習主席將在幾週後訪美，顯示兩國並未因伊朗制裁問題中斷元首會晤的準備工作。
美國駐中國大使龐德偉週三在北京會見中國外交部長王毅等官員，討論習近平即將對華盛頓進行的國是訪問。中國外交部發布的會談內容也提到，雙方將為下一階段的重要高層互動做好準備。
清華大學戰略與安全研究中心博士後研究員 Jodie Wen 表示，目前除了貝森特的警告之外，美方尚未公布具體制裁措施，因此現階段更像是一項警告。
她認為，川普與習近平今年 5 月會晤後，美中關係已轉向「可控競爭」，有別於拜登政府將中國視為戰略對手的定位。
中國對美國針對伊朗祭出的次級制裁，目前反應相對克制。北京僅表示將採取一切必要措施維護自身權益，但沒有說明可能採取哪些行動。中國外交部被問及是否曾就伊朗問題與美方溝通時，也表示沒有相關資訊可以提供，但證實兩國正討論川普與習近平會晤事宜。
布魯金斯學會中國中心主任 Ryan Hass 認為，由於美方在宣布制裁前並未進行充分鋪陳，北京可能將相關威脅視為政治表態，而非準備立即對中國大型金融機構採取行動。
Hass 指出，貝森特先前曾反問，為何美國要摧毀全球金融體系，北京可能據此判斷，華府不會對中國主要金融機構下手。他預估，美中貿易休戰仍將維持，因為關係再度惡化對雙方都更不利。
亞洲集團中國區董事總經理 Han Shen Lin 表示，中國目前的法律機制也為企業提供一定調整空間。中國企業的海外銀行可以遵守美國規定，但在中國境內仍須以中國法律為優先，使北京得以在維護自身利益的同時，有限度地配合美國制裁要求。
paras_en: CNBC reported that as U.S. and Chinese officials prepare for Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington next month, U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 27th) again stepped up pressure on Beijing, hinting that he would not rule out sanctioning Chinese banks that help facilitate Iran's oil transactions.

Trump told the media on Thursday that he "might sanction Chinese banks" and said he does not have to announce every measure in advance. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen earlier this week also warned that Chinese banks that turn Iranian oil into cash and thereby support Iran's government could become targets of U.S. sanctions.

Even as the White House’s language toward China has grown tougher, high‑level contacts between the two sides continue. Trump said President Xi will visit the United States in a few weeks, indicating that the two countries have not halted preparations for a summit despite the Iran‑sanctions issue.

U.S. Ambassador to China R. Nicholas Burns met on Wednesday in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials to discuss Xi’s upcoming state visit to Washington. The Chinese foreign ministry’s statement on the talks also said the sides will prepare for the next stage of important senior‑level interactions.

Jodie Wen, a post‑doctoral researcher at Tsinghua University’s Center for Strategic and Security Studies, said that aside from Yellen’s warning, the United States has not yet announced any concrete sanction measures, so at this stage it is more of a warning.

She believes that after Trump’s May meeting with Xi, U.S.–China relations have shifted to a "managed competition" model, different from the Biden administration’s view of China as a strategic adversary.

China’s response to the U.S. secondary sanctions on Iran has been relatively restrained. Beijing said it would take all necessary measures to protect its own interests but did not specify what actions might be taken. When asked if it had communicated with the U.S. on the Iran issue, the Chinese foreign ministry said it had no relevant information to share, but confirmed that the two countries are discussing the Trump‑Xi meeting.

Ryan Hass, director of the Brookings Institution’s China Center, said that because the U.S. has not laid out a full narrative before announcing sanctions, Beijing may view the threat as a political statement rather than an imminent move against its large financial institutions.

Hass noted that Yellen had previously asked why the United States would want to destroy the global financial system, and Beijing might infer from that that Washington will not target China’s major banks. He predicts the U.S.–China trade truce will hold, as a further deterioration would hurt both sides.

Han Shen Lin, managing director for Asia at a major Chinese conglomerate, said China’s legal framework gives companies some leeway. Overseas Chinese banks can comply with U.S. rules, but within China they must prioritize Chinese law, allowing Beijing to protect its interests while only partially accommodating U.S. sanction demands.

items.title: 〈房產〉新青安謝幕總計撥款近1.4兆元逾17萬戶受惠 青安3.0接棒將再衝
items.title_en: <Real Estate> New Qing'an Wraps Up with Nearly NT$1.4 Trillion Disbursed, Over 170,000 Households Benefited; Qing'an 3.0 Takes Over to Push Further
paras: 一稱新青安的青安政策2.0在今年7月底功成身退，房仲業者根據官方統計，總結青安2.0期間的撥貸狀況， 3年間共撥貸約17.7萬戶，總金額將近1.4兆元！換算每戶平均撥貸金額達782萬元，比前期的青安1.0大增300萬元；平均每月撥貸戶數也將近5000件，更較前一波青安1.0的1737件增加近兩倍。
台灣房屋趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，青安2.0於2023年8月實施，不僅將額度上限拉高至1000萬元，還一口氣將年期上限拉長到40年期，並提供最長5年的寬限期，大幅強化了申貸民眾的購買力，因此國人對政策相當捧場，且傾向貸好貸滿，使撥貸戶數直線上升，平均每戶撥貸金額也大躍進。
青安2.0貸款方案，一度掀起購屋熱潮，加上初期甄審較寬鬆，引發人頭戶炒作的疑慮，因此2024年中開始政策收緊，也讓青安2.0後期的熱度較前期略有降溫，直到今年7月因搶搭末班車效應，單月撥貸戶數才站回5000戶大關，相關限制也延續到了接棒的青安3.0。
2026年8月上路的青安3.0，維持了新青安每人一生只能貸一次的限制，還進一步設下申貸人年所得低於200萬元、年齡未滿50歲的排富及排老條款，且各地購屋總價也增訂上限；僅針對婚育家庭加碼，最高可貸1500萬元。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中指出，青安3.0的整體貸款門檻比青安2.0更嚴格，加上現今房市景氣與新青安時期的落差不小，且市面上的低總價物件在青安2.0的3年期間，也已消化不少，因此青安3.0對房市雖可發揮剛需支撐的作用，但預估月均申貸量將持平發展，不至於重演新青安前期的爆量熱潮；而平均每戶撥貸金額，則可能受婚育家庭額度增加、房價水位居高不下的影響，持續向上攀升。
paras_en: The so‑called “New Qing'an” Qing'an 2.0 policy completed its rollout at the end of July this year. According to official statistics compiled by real‑estate agents, during the three‑year Qing'an 2.0 period about 177,000 households received loans totaling nearly NT$1.4 trillion, an average of NT$7.82 million per household – NT$3 million more than the earlier Qing'an 1.0. The average monthly number of disbursed loans approached 5,000, almost double the 1,737 per month seen in the previous wave.

Taiwan Housing Trend Center CEO Zhang Xulan said Qing'an 2.0, launched in August 2023, not only raised the loan ceiling to NT$10 million but also extended the maximum term to 40 years and offered up to five years of grace period, greatly strengthening borrowers’ purchasing power. Consequently, the public embraced the policy, tended to borrow the full amount, and the number of disbursed loans rose sharply while the average loan per household jumped significantly.

Qing'an 2.0 loan schemes sparked a home‑buying frenzy, and the relatively lax initial screening raised concerns about speculative “one‑person‑one‑house” activity. The policy was tightened from mid‑2024, cooling the later stage of Qing'an 2.0 compared with its early boom. Only in July this year did the “last‑train” effect push monthly disbursements back to the 5,000‑household level, and the related restrictions will carry over to the successor Qing'an 3.0.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉南俊國際奪輝達VR與ASIC大單激勵 早盤一字鎖漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Nan Jun International Secures Nvidia VR and ASIC Mega Orders, Opens at Limit‑Up
paras: 伺服器滑軌大廠南俊國際(6584-TW)在櫃買中心業績發表會釋出強勁營運展望，受惠於通用型伺服器缺料問題紓解，加上輝達最新Vera Rubin系列滑軌與雲端大廠ASIC伺服器滑軌於第3季正式啟動出貨，激勵今(28)日買盤進駐，早盤以680元跳空開出後衝上漲停價682元，隨即漲停打開，成交量放大近5倍。
南俊國際指出第2季為今年營運低點，隨著下半年通用型伺服器與高階AI新機種陸續放量，營運將重回逐季成長軌道。

預期今年Vera Rubin終端客戶數將較GB系列增加三至四家，搭配9月接棒量產出貨的美系客戶氣冷ASIC伺服器滑軌，將推升整體AI營收占比。
南俊國際透過建立超過30種截面規格與專利庫，大幅縮短客製化開發時程三至六個月，並由專職工程師定期監控同業專利動態且配合外部鑑定，確保在避開侵權風險下將新產品導入差距縮小至一季以內。

The stock opened at TWD 680, quickly jumped to the limit‑up price of TWD 682, then fell back as the limit was lifted, with volume swelling to nearly five times the norm.

Nan Jun International noted that Q2 was the low point of this year’s operations, but as generic servers and high‑end AI models ramp up in the second half, performance is expected to return to a quarterly growth trajectory.

Previously, Nvidia’s GB series faced limited market share and shipments due to delayed product introductions and certification compared with peers. The next‑generation Vera Rubin series has now caught up in development schedule, with a small shipment start in August and volume deliveries to leading cloud service providers slated for September.

It is projected that the number of Vera Rubin end‑customers this year will increase by three to four compared with the GB series. Coupled with the September rollout of mass‑produced, US‑based air‑cooled ASIC server rails, this should boost the overall AI revenue share.

Nan Jun International has built a library of over 30 cross‑section specifications and patents, cutting custom development cycles by three to six months. Dedicated engineers regularly monitor industry patent activity and work with external assessments to ensure new products are introduced while avoiding infringement risks, narrowing the gap to within one quarter.

items.title: 美國號召G20寬鬆監管AI 馬斯克、黃仁勳、奧特曼將出席
items.title_en: US Calls for G20 to Adopt Looser AI Regulation, Musk, Jensen Huang and Altman to Attend

一名白宮官員表示，美國將力促 G20 成員國簽署一項不具約束力的協議，主張以較寬鬆的方式監管 AI。該協議將呼籲各國避免成立新的監管機構，並與民間企業合作測試新興技術。
克拉茨歐斯在聲明中表示：「我們期待就更明智的監管方式、降低AI應用門檻，以及強化勞動力發展計畫進行深入討論，這些措施將推動全球經濟繁榮。」
OpenAI發言人表示，奧特曼將與美國商務部長盧特尼克進行爐邊對談，討論 AI 技術即將迎來的發展。黃仁勳的發言人則拒絕評論其出席安排。

paras_en: Reuters, citing sources, reported that NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are scheduled to attend next week’s G20 ministerial meeting in Raleigh, North Carolina, which will focus on technology issues.

A spokesperson for White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios said the United States has also arranged for SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk, Meta Platforms (META-US) President Dina Powell McCormick, and venture capitalist and former White House AI adviser David Sacks to deliver remarks via video link, with the speeches slated for September 1.

A White House official said the United States will push G20 members to sign a non‑binding agreement advocating a more relaxed approach to AI regulation, urging countries to avoid creating new regulatory bodies and to work with private firms to test emerging technologies.

Kratos said in the statement, “We look forward to in‑depth discussions on smarter regulation, lowering the barriers to AI adoption, and strengthening workforce development programs, measures that will drive global economic prosperity.”

An OpenAI spokesperson said Altman will have a fireside chat with U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo to discuss the imminent developments in AI technology, while Huang’s spokesperson declined to comment on his attendance plans.

The meeting is one of a series of G20‑related gatherings in the coming months, preparing for the G20 Leaders’ Summit in Miami this December. The United States chairs this year’s G20, and according to the event website, technology and commerce officials from member states will discuss “AI and other emerging technologies” at the Raleigh meeting.

items.title: 西藏尼泊爾邊境山洪 90名美國人失聯 川普回應
items.title_en: Tibetan-Nepal Border Flash Flood Leaves 90 Americans Missing, Trump Responds
paras: 美國總統川普27日（周四）表示，尼泊爾爆發山洪，已有數十名美國人失聯，美國已向尼泊爾提供援助。

paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday, the 27th, that a flash flood has erupted in Nepal, leaving dozens of Americans missing, and that the United States has provided assistance to Nepal.

When asked about the Nepal flash flood and the missing Americans, Trump said, "It's terrible, we have already contacted Nepal and offered them all the help they need. You know, our relationship with Nepal is very good, and this flood is extremely brutal."
He added, "No one has ever seen anything like this; those solid, well‑built structures were swept away like toothpicks."
Trump claimed that roughly 50 to 60 Americans are missing, though he has not received a complete list of the missing. The U.S. State Department reported that 90 Americans were missing that day.
According to Nepalese police, the flash flood in the northern part of the country has already caused at least 389 deaths.

CNN reported on the 27th that among more than 1,300 missing persons, there are over 700 foreign nationals from more than twenty countries. Malaysia’s foreign ministry said 55 of its citizens are unaccounted for; Ukraine’s foreign ministry said at least 56 Ukrainians remain missing; Canada’s foreign minister Anand said at least 30 Canadian citizens and permanent residents are missing; and the Australian government said at least 39 Australians are missing.

If nominations are delayed or politically blocked, the industry’s development blueprint could remain unapproved and the administration unable to budget for it, greatly increasing bureaucratic complexity and operational risk.

Moreover, the unmanned‑vehicle sector is characterized by high R&D costs and high technical barriers, making it heavily dependent on stable, predictable government procurement orders to share research risk. Limiting purchases to the annual public‑budget line will expose related funds to budget crowding, delayed reviews or substantial cuts. Taiwan’s domestic unmanned‑vehicle supply chain already links over 274 companies across chips, communications, flight control and system integration. Without continuous procurement orders, firms will face higher operating costs and financing pressure, and private investment enthusiasm will be severely dampened.

The Ministry emphasized that regardless of how the amendment proceeds, it will continue to stand with the domestic industry. It will leverage existing coordinated programs to help firms deepen core autonomous technologies, strengthen the local ecosystem, expand into international markets, accelerate the building of a reliable non‑Chinese supply‑chain system, and ensure Taiwan’s defense security and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉南俊國際奪輝達VR與ASIC大單激勵 早盤一字鎖漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Nan Jun International Secures Nvidia VR and ASIC Mega Orders, Opens at Limit‑Up
paras: 伺服器滑軌大廠南俊國際(6584-TW)在櫃買中心業績發表會釋出強勁營運展望，受惠於通用型伺服器缺料問題紓解，加上輝達最新Vera Rubin系列滑軌與雲端大廠ASIC伺服器滑軌於第3季正式啟動出貨，激勵今(28)日買盤進駐，早盤以680元跳空開出後衝上漲停價682元，隨即漲停打開，成交量放大近5倍。
南俊國際指出第2季為今年營運低點，隨著下半年通用型伺服器與高階AI新機種陸續放量，營運將重回逐季成長軌道。
先前輝達GB系列因新產品導入與認證進度落後同業，導致市占率與出貨受限，但次世代Vera Rubin系列開發時程已全面跟上，8月啟動少量出貨並將於9月放量交付一線雲端服務供應商。
預期今年Vera Rubin終端客戶數將較GB系列增加三至四家，搭配9月接棒量產出貨的美系客戶氣冷ASIC伺服器滑軌，將推升整體AI營收占比。
南俊國際透過建立超過30種截面規格與專利庫，大幅縮短客製化開發時程三至六個月，並由專職工程師定期監控同業專利動態且配合外部鑑定，確保在避開侵權風險下將新產品導入差距縮小至一季以內。
paras_en: Server rail giant Nan Jun International (6584‑TW) unveiled a strong operating outlook at the OTC market’s earnings briefing. Benefiting from the easing shortage of generic servers and the launch of Nvidia’s latest Vera Rubin rail series and cloud‑scale ASIC server rails in Q3, buying pressure surged on the 28th. The stock opened at TWD 680, quickly jumped to the limit‑up price of TWD 682, then fell back as the limit was lifted, with volume swelling to nearly five times the norm.

Nan Jun International noted that Q2 was the low point of this year’s operations, but as generic servers and high‑end AI models ramp up in the second half, performance is expected to return to a quarterly growth trajectory.

Previously, Nvidia’s GB series faced limited market share and shipments due to delayed product introductions and certification compared with peers. The next‑generation Vera Rubin series has now caught up in development schedule, with a small shipment start in August and volume deliveries to leading cloud service providers slated for September.

It is projected that the number of Vera Rubin end‑customers this year will increase by three to four compared with the GB series. Coupled with the September rollout of mass‑produced, US‑based air‑cooled ASIC server rails, this should boost the overall AI revenue share.

Nan Jun International has built a library of over 30 cross‑section specifications and patents, cutting custom development cycles by three to six months. Dedicated engineers regularly monitor industry patent activity and work with external assessments to ensure new products are introduced while avoiding infringement risks, narrowing the gap to within one quarter.

items.title: 統一投信攜手大三億營造推動員工福儲信託 彰化銀行擔任信託機構
items.title_en: Unified Investment Trust Partners with DaSanYi Construction to Launch Employee Welfare Savings Trust, Changhua Bank Serves as Trust Institution
paras: 統一投信攜手營造大廠「大三億營造」正式開辦「員工福利儲蓄信託」計畫， 信託受託機構由彰化銀行擔任，三方已圓滿完成簽約儀式。統一投信憑藉逾30年的專業投研實力，積極發揮資產管理領導品牌的影響力，本次透過福儲信託業務，將資產增值的引擎延伸至企業員工退休規劃領域，成為企業共好與員工福利升級的關鍵推手，也為落實ESG永續留才，創造了跨產業服務的新里程碑。
統一投信自辦員工福儲信託長達18年，透過制度化投資紀律，助力員工放大退休資產。正因為長年運作福儲，從制度設計、流程規劃到實務問題排除，累積豐富的實戰經驗，成為打造幸福職場「陪跑者」的絕佳優勢，期望達到「企業留才、員工留財」的目標。

統一投信今年向外擴大推動員工福儲信託業務，號召更多企業攜手加入「幸福企業大聯盟」，至今已吸引逾10家企業簽約與洽談，預計受惠員工突破千人。福儲標的嚴選旗下人氣基金，打造「積極、成長、穩健」三種組合，例如：統一奔騰、統一黑馬、統一全球新科技、統一台灣高息優選基金，以滿足不同風險偏好的員工需求。在簽約後，亦有完善的售後服務，例如：舉辦員工福儲教育訓練、理財講座，提供專業的投資組合檢視、年度優化與市場分析報告，以協助員工建立正確理財觀念與掌握資產動態。
大三億營造為深化員工福利、保障同仁的退休生活，宣布開辦福儲信託計畫，採用「員工自提、公司相對提撥」的雙軌機制，藉由定期定額的資產累積，為同仁實現「變相加薪」、放大複利效益。
大三億董事長魏瑞伯表示：「我們始終相信，每位同仁都是公司最珍貴的資產與一路走來最堅定的夥伴。本次導入福儲信託，不僅是把企業經營成果轉化為實質的福利照顧，更是公司對大家長遠承諾的展現。」透過這份「陪伴員工慢慢變老」的初心，期待讓每一位同仁在專注事業的同時，也能無後顧之憂擁抱幸福生活。未來，公司將持續優化職場環境，打造充滿人情味與永續價值的幸福企業。
彰化銀行長年深耕信託市場，擁有豐富的資產管理、財富傳承及信託監察經驗，今年更以優質的員工福利信託服務榮獲信託評鑑獎項肯定。本次攜手統一投信，結合雙方在信託服務與專業投資領域的專長，為大三億營造員工建立兼具安全、透明與收益潛力的長期理財平台，協助企業完善員工福利制度，強化人才留任與人力資源管理。
統一投信提醒，投資人選擇配息型基金時，需留意基金過去配息不代表未來配息，亦可觀察相關金融市場的政經議題變化，作為投資布局時的參考依據，金融商品的淨值有可能因各項總經或產業因素變化而上下波動。
paras_en: Unified Investment Trust has teamed up with major construction firm DaSanYi Construction to officially launch an "Employee Welfare Savings Trust" program, with Changhua Bank acting as the trust institution. The three parties have successfully completed the signing ceremony. Leveraging over 30 years of professional investment research expertise, Unified Investment Trust actively extends its asset‑management leadership influence into corporate employee retirement planning through this welfare‑savings trust, becoming a key driver for corporate mutual benefit and employee benefit upgrades, and creating a new cross‑industry service milestone for ESG‑driven talent retention.

For 18 years, Unified Investment Trust has run its own employee welfare savings trust, using disciplined, systematic investing to help staff grow their retirement assets. This long‑term operation has built rich practical experience in system design, process planning and problem solving, giving it a strong advantage as a "partner" in creating happy workplaces and aiming for the goal of "retaining talent for the company and wealth for employees."

This year, Unified Investment Trust is expanding the employee welfare savings trust business outward, inviting more companies to join its "Happy Enterprise Alliance." To date, more than ten companies have signed or are in talks, with expected beneficiary employees exceeding a thousand. The trust selects popular in‑house funds to create three portfolios—"Aggressive," "Growth" and "Stable"—such as Unified Bente, Unified Black Horse, Unified Global New Technology, and Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Preferred Fund, to meet varying risk preferences. After signing, comprehensive after‑sales services are provided, including employee welfare education, financial seminars, professional portfolio reviews, annual optimization and market analysis reports, helping staff develop sound financial habits and stay informed about their assets.

DaSanYi Construction, to deepen employee benefits and secure retirees’ livelihoods, announced the launch of a welfare savings trust using a dual‑track mechanism of "employee contributions and proportional company matching." Through regular, systematic asset accumulation, the plan aims to deliver a form of "de‑facto salary increase" and amplify compound‑interest gains for staff.

Chairman Wei Ruibo of DaSanYi said, "We have always believed that every employee is the company's most precious asset and steadfast partner. Introducing this welfare savings trust not only turns corporate results into tangible benefits but also demonstrates the company's long‑term commitment to its people." With this "accompanying employees as they age" mindset, the firm hopes each staff member can focus on work without worries and enjoy a happy life. Going forward, the company will continue to improve the workplace environment, building a humane, sustainable, happy enterprise.

Changhua Bank, a long‑standing player in the trust market with extensive experience in asset management, wealth succession and trust oversight, received a trust evaluation award this year for its quality employee welfare trust services. Partnering with Unified Investment Trust, the bank combines its trust service expertise with investment professionalism to create a secure, transparent, and potentially rewarding long‑term financial platform for DaSanYi employees, helping the company enhance its welfare system, strengthen talent retention, and improve human‑resource management.

Unified Investment Trust reminds investors that past dividend distributions of a fund do not guarantee future payouts. Investors should also monitor political and economic developments in financial markets as part of their investment strategy, as net asset values can fluctuate due to macroeconomic or industry factors.

items.title: 長榮海運參展2026亞太永續博覽會 展出大型高擬真船模型
items.title_en: Evergreen Marine Exhibits at 2026 Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo with Large High-Fidelity Ship Model
paras: 2026第五屆亞太永續博覽會今（27）日於台北世貿一館登場，為期三天。長榮海運今年以「潔淨動能．智慧領航」為主題參展，展場規劃包括全新引進的雙能源船、IoT智能冷櫃以及人才永續等三大主軸。現場特別展出全新E型貨櫃船1:200高擬真船模，讓民眾從一艘船出發，透過互動模式，近距離認識航運業推動能源轉型及保護海洋環境的具體行動。此外展場也設置拍貼機，民眾可以自行挑選喜歡的相框，拍攝專屬照片，以手機掃描QR Code保存相片，為這趟永續航運探索留下美好回憶。

為使民眾深入了解大型貨櫃船的環保科技，此次展出的大型船模為16,000TEU的長生輪(EVER ECO)，該艘船為長榮海運首艘使用甲醇替代燃料的「ZNZ雙能源環保貨櫃船」，除配置雙燃料主機外，船上亦裝設節能導風罩、空氣潤滑系統及壓艙水處理系統等多項先進環保設備。節能導風罩可降低船舶航行時所受到的大氣阻力；空氣潤滑系統則是透過船底形成氣泡層，減少船體與海水間的摩擦阻力，進而降低燃料消耗及溫室氣體排放；壓艙水處理系統則有助於降低水中生物隨船舶跨區域移動的風險，減少外來物種對當地海洋生態系統可能造成的影響。

長榮海運也特別於現場安排專人導覽解說，讓民眾認識各項環保設備功能，並透過互動體驗，認識一艘大型貨櫃船如何從船舶設計、能源效率到生態保護，一步步為航運永續發展做好準備。同時也透過智能冷櫃IoT的介紹，讓參觀者了解長榮海運以IoT物聯網科技傳遞運送過程中的優勢，無論是新鮮蔬果、生技醫療或生鮮海產，即使相隔千里也能透過IoT智能系統，讓客戶有如親臨現場，隨時隨地監控溫溼度及氣體環境，全面提升貨物運輸品質及營運管理的實際效用。
此外在人才永續專區，也讓民眾了解長榮海運新型貨櫃船上安全舒適的生活空間及工作環境，提供船員媲美豪華郵輪的交誼廳、視聽設備、餐廳及健身房等起居空間，並讓每位船員都享有專屬個人房間及衛浴設備。
長榮海運表示，面對國際社會對永續發展的高度期待，公司積極響應國際海事組織（IMO）2050 年航運淨零排放目標，目前已訂造55 艘 ZNZ 雙能源環保船，涵蓋甲醇與LNG雙燃料船型，期望透過此次展覽，以貼近生活、容易理解的方式，讓更多民眾了解長榮海運在ESG方面所做的努力，如何運用科技回應氣候變遷，兼顧海洋生態保護，同時鼓勵民眾一起愛護地球，為永續盡一份心力。
paras_en: The 2026 5th Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo opened today (27th) at Taipei World Trade Center Hall 1 and will run for three days. Evergreen Marine participated this year under the theme “Clean Power, Smart Navigation,” focusing on three main pillars: a newly introduced dual‑fuel vessel, IoT smart refrigerated containers, and talent sustainability. A brand‑new E‑type container ship model at a 1:200 scale was displayed, allowing the public to start from a single ship and, through interactive modes, learn up close the concrete actions the shipping industry is taking to drive energy transition and protect the marine environment. A photo booth was also set up where visitors could choose a frame, take a personalized picture and save it by scanning a QR code with their phone, creating a pleasant memory of this sustainability‑focused voyage.

To help the public grasp the green technology of large container ships, the exhibit featured a 16,000‑TEU vessel model called EVER ECO. This is Evergreen’s first “ZNZ” dual‑fuel eco‑container ship that uses methanol as fuel. In addition to dual‑fuel engines, the ship is equipped with an energy‑saving wind‑deflector, an air‑lubrication system, and a ballast‑water treatment system, among other advanced eco‑features. The wind‑deflector reduces atmospheric resistance while the ship is underway; the air‑lubrication system creates a bubble layer under the hull to cut friction between hull and water, thereby lowering fuel consumption and greenhouse‑gas emissions; the ballast‑water treatment system helps reduce the risk of transporting aquatic organisms across regions, mitigating the impact of invasive species on local marine ecosystems.

Evergreen also arranged dedicated guides on site to explain the functions of each environmental device, and through interactive experiences showed how a large container ship prepares for sustainable development step by step—from ship design and energy efficiency to ecological protection. The exhibition also highlighted IoT smart refrigerated containers, demonstrating how Evergreen uses IoT technology to convey advantages throughout the transport process. Whether shipping fresh produce, biotech medicines, or live seafood, the IoT system lets customers monitor temperature, humidity and gas conditions in real time as if they were on site, greatly improving cargo quality and operational management.

In the talent‑sustainability zone, visitors learned about the safe and comfortable living and working spaces on Evergreen’s new container ships, which offer crew members amenities comparable to luxury cruise liners, including lounges, audiovisual equipment, restaurants and gyms, as well as private cabins with en‑suite bathrooms for each crew member.

Evergreen stated that, facing the international community’s high expectations for sustainable development, the company is actively responding to the International Maritime Organization’s 2050 net‑zero emissions target. It has already ordered 55 ZNZ dual‑fuel eco‑ships covering both methanol and LNG fuel types. Through this exhibition, Evergreen aims to present its ESG efforts in an accessible, everyday‑friendly manner, showing how technology is used to address climate change while protecting marine ecosystems, and encouraging the public to care for the planet and contribute to sustainability.

items.title: 外資熱錢回籠！不只抱權值股 狂敲00403A、00981A奪冠亞軍
items.title_en: Foreign Hot Money Returns! Not Just Targeting Blue‑Chip Stocks, Aggressively Buying 00403A and 00981A to Claim Champion and Runner‑Up
paras: 隨著大型雲端服務商加速投入資本支出，國內科技產業發展穩健向上，國發會最新公布7月分景氣燈號，連續8個月亮起景氣熱絡的紅燈，基本面強勁，外資連續兩天回籠。值得一提的是，這次熱錢進攻的焦點不再只是傳統權值股，而是主動式ETF雙雄－主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)，居外資連二買冠亞軍。
觀察外資買超兩日排行榜，外資買超榜首由「主動統一升級50」強勢奪下，2日狂砸買超張數高達144,264張，緊隨其後的第二名則是「主動統一台股增長」，同樣獲得外資敲進61,102張。其餘包括華邦電、凱基金、台塑都獲得外資連兩天掃貨。
在外資撐盤下，00403A、00981A今天股價雙雙向上挺進，00403A盤中最高衝到10.44元；00981A則勁揚超過2%，盤中重新站回30元之上。
分析師指出，台股在4萬6千點震盪走高，隨著輝達財報亮眼，國內景氣火熱，都成了外資在反彈路上熱錢提前回流的底氣，外資連續兩日買超兵力集結在00403A、00981A，主要是看中「主動選股」的超額報酬能力。在景氣連續亮紅燈、科技股評價相對高位之際，法人避開單一個股的波動風險，選擇由專業經理人主動挑選、彈性調配優質AI供應鏈與潛力股，藉此卡位接下來的台股升級增長行情。
展望後市，統一台股研究團隊分析，短期受到美期中大選影響，加上聯準會政策的不確定性，股市將呈現震盪整理格局。不過台股基本面良好，中長線來看有望在上述不確定性淡去後，於Q4展開向上行情。長期而言，投資布局將聚焦先進製程，包含含廠務、設備、封裝等，及AI基礎設施關鍵零組件，如 HVDC(高壓直流)機櫃電源模組與CPO(光纖)，和進入漲價循環的記憶體、ABF/PCB上游材料及被動元件。

paras_en: As major cloud service providers accelerate capital expenditures, Taiwan’s technology sector is developing steadily upward. The National Development Council just released the July economic indicator, lighting a red “hot economy” signal for the eighth consecutive month, indicating strong fundamentals and prompting foreign investors to return capital for two consecutive days. Notably, this wave of hot money is no longer focused solely on traditional blue‑chip stocks but is targeting the two active‑management ETFs – Active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Active Uni‑Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW), which have become the top two picks among foreign investors.

Looking at the foreign‑investor net‑buy ranking over the past two days, the top spot was seized by “Active Uni‑Upgrade 50,” which saw a massive net purchase of 144,264 lots on the second day. Close behind, the runner‑up was “Active Uni‑Taiwan Stock Growth,” also attracting foreign inflows with a net purchase of 61,102 lots. Other names such as Winbond, KGI Fund, and Formosa Plastics also saw foreign investors buying heavily for two consecutive days.

Supported by foreign buying, both 00403A and 00981A rose today, with 00403A reaching an intraday high of NT$10.44, while 00981A surged more than 2% and reclaimed a level above NT$30 during the session.

Analysts point out that the Taiwan market, hovering around the 46,000‑point mark, is buoyed by Nvidia’s strong earnings and a hot domestic economy, giving foreign investors confidence to bring hot money back ahead of a rebound. Their two‑day net‑buy focus on 00403A and 00981A reflects confidence in the “active‑stock‑selection” excess‑return capability. With the economy flashing red signals and tech‑stock valuations at relatively high levels, institutions are avoiding single‑stock volatility risk and opting for professionally managed, actively selected portfolios that flexibly allocate to high‑quality AI supply‑chain and growth stocks, positioning themselves for the next phase of Taiwan market growth.

Looking ahead, Uni‑Taiwan’s research team expects short‑term market volatility due to the U.S. mid‑term elections and uncertainty around Federal Reserve policy, likely resulting in a consolidating pattern. However, Taiwan’s fundamentals remain solid, and in the medium‑to‑long term, the market could resume an upward trend in Q4 once these uncertainties fade. Over the longer horizon, investment focus will shift to advanced‑process assets—including fabs, equipment, and packaging—as well as key AI infrastructure components such as HVDC power‑module cabinets and CPO fiber, together with memory, ABF/PCB upstream materials and passive components entering a price‑rise cycle.
