items.title: 從重工業到創新綠洲！亞灣新創大南方登場 龔明鑫讚高雄躍升新興科技產業核心
items.title_en: From Heavy Industry to an Innovative Oasis! Asia Bay Startup Hub South Emerges, Minister Gong Ming‑Xin Praises Kaohsiung's Rise as a Core of Emerging Tech Industries
paras: 經濟部長龔明鑫今 (28) 日於高雄出席2026 Meet Greater South亞灣新創大南方開幕活動，他於會前受訪時強調，亞灣新創生態圈推動近6年來成果斐然，高雄已成功從傳統重工業城市，轉型為引領未來的新興科技產業重鎮。
經濟部長龔明鑫出席2026 Meet Greater South亞灣新創大南方開幕活動，受訪時表示，這項活動緣起於5、6年前，中央單位特別借鏡台北經驗，協助高雄建立新創生態圈。經歷近6年的努力，高雄展現極大的轉型力道，與初期新創團隊多需從外地引進的狀況相比，如今南部在地新創生態體系已非常完整且成熟，發展潛力巨大。
龔明鑫指出，參觀亞灣現場許多前瞻技術與團隊後，對其創新活力印象深刻。這幾年高雄的轉型成果有目共睹，不僅引進諸多前瞻科技企業，更吸引國內外晶片巨頭與系統大廠進駐。此外，結合嘉義亞洲無人機AI創新應用中心等區域資源，共同串聯起南部整體科技產業鏈。
龔明鑫表示，雖然產業界近期面臨全球經濟與創新調適等諸多外部挑戰，但在中央與地方政府全力合作下，成功將過往的轉型疑慮一掃而空。他充滿信心強調，只要產業團結一致並持續推動創新轉型，南部科技產業必定能克服眼前難關，迎接更耀眼的未來發展前景。
paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑Xin attended the opening of the 2026 Meet Greater South Asia Bay Startup Hub South in Kaohsiung today (the 28th). In a pre‑event interview he stressed that the Asia Bay startup ecosystem has achieved remarkable results over the past six years, and Kaohsiung has successfully transformed from a traditional heavy‑industry city into a leading hub for future emerging technology industries.

Minister Gong said the event originated five to six years ago when central authorities, taking a cue from Taipei’s experience, helped Kaohsiung build a startup ecosystem. After nearly six years of effort, Kaohsiung has shown great transformational power; unlike the early days when many startup teams had to be brought in from elsewhere, the southern region now boasts a very complete and mature local startup ecosystem with huge development potential.

Gong noted that after touring the Asia Bay site and seeing many forward‑looking technologies and teams, he was deeply impressed by its innovative vitality. Kaohsiung’s transformation results are evident to all – not only have numerous cutting‑edge tech firms been attracted, but also major domestic and foreign chip giants and system manufacturers have set up operations. Moreover, by linking regional resources such as the Chiayi Asia Drone AI Innovation Application Center, a comprehensive southern technology industry chain is being woven together.

Gong acknowledged that the industry currently faces many external challenges, including the global economy and innovation adjustments, but under the full cooperation of central and local governments, past doubts about the transformation have been swept away. He expressed strong confidence that as long as the industry stays united and continues to drive innovative transformation, the southern tech sector will overcome current difficulties and embrace an even brighter future.

items.title: 安成生技4.5億元銀彈到位 持續推進核心新藥臨床試驗Q4公布結果
items.title_en: Ancheng Biotech Secures NT$450 Million Funding, Continues Advancing Core Drug Clinical Trial with Q4 Results Announcement
paras: 安成生技(6610-TW)宣布，順利完成今年度現金增資，此次現增以每股新台幣25元發行普通股18,000,000股，合計募集4.5億元。此外，安成生技旗下核心新藥AC-203的全球二/三期樞紐性臨床試驗EBShield Study已進入最後階段，並在第四季公布主要療效結果。
安成生技指出，AC-203用於治療單純型遺傳性表皮分解性水皰症(EBS)，其全球二/三期樞紐性臨床試驗EBShield Study已完成81位受試者收案，並完成所有受試者主藥療效指標評估，試驗已進入最後階段，預計第四季公布主藥療效結果。
安成生技表示，隨著此次現增資金到位，除充實營運資源，也同步進行AC-2036後續臨床開發、全球法規申請及未來商業化準備。
除AC-203，安成生技提到，產品管線也包含NORA520及AC-1101，涵蓋罕見疾病、發炎性皮膚疾病及中樞神經用藥等領域。
paras_en: Ancheng Biotech (6610‑TW) announced that it has successfully completed its cash capital increase for the year, issuing 18,000,000 ordinary shares at NT$25 per share and raising a total of NT$450 million. In addition, the company’s core drug AC‑203 is now in the final stage of its global pivotal Phase II/III EBShield Study, with primary efficacy results slated for release in Q4.

Ancheng Biotech noted that AC‑203, intended to treat simple‑type hereditary epidermolysis bullosa (EBS), has completed enrollment of 81 subjects in the global pivotal Phase II/III EBShield Study and has finished efficacy assessments for the primary endpoint in all participants. The trial is now in its final stage, with primary efficacy results expected to be announced in Q4.

The company said that with the newly raised capital now in place, it will not only bolster its operating resources but also proceed with further clinical development of AC‑2036, worldwide regulatory filings, and preparations for future commercialization.
Beyond AC‑203, Ancheng Biotech mentioned that its pipeline also includes NORA520 and AC‑1101, covering rare diseases, inflammatory skin disorders, and central‑nervous‑system therapeutics.

items.title: 黃仁勳身價一日暴增149億美元 超越祖克柏躍居全球第六
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Net Worth Jumps $14.9 B in One Day, Surpassing Zuckerberg to Rank Sixth Globally
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)股價周四(27日)上漲8.7%，此前公司公布第二季財報及財測。強勁的股價表現也推升了輝達執行長黃仁勳的身價。
黃仁勳曾在一家Denny"s餐廳內創辦輝達，並協助打造如今全球市值最高的公司。
輝達股價周四收於227.98美元，接近236.54美元的歷史新高。
根據《富比士》資料，隨著周四股價上漲，黃仁勳身價估計增加149億美元，按美元計算，成為當天所有億萬富豪中身價增加最多的人。
這149億美元的增幅，使黃仁勳身價升至1,961億美元。這位持有這家半導體巨頭約3%股份的創辦人兼執行長，身價單日大增8.2%。
隨著身價增加，黃仁勳在《富比士》億萬富豪榜上的排名升至第六名，身價達1,961億美元。周四，黃仁勳超越了祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)的1,956億美元與Larry Ellison的1,936億美元身價。祖克柏身價周四減少23億美元，而Ellison則增加24億美元。
排名在黃仁勳之前的是位居第五名的戴爾(Michael Dell)。戴爾是周四身價增加第二多的富豪，增加32億美元，使其總身價達2,434億美元。
如今黃仁勳的身價僅略高於祖克柏與Ellison，但仍落後戴爾超過450億美元，因此在再次向上攀升之前，他的排名更有可能跌出全球前十大富豪之列。
輝達股價飆升
輝達股價周四大漲，分析師與投資人正在消化公司第二季財報及財測。
輝達周三公布季度業績後，股價最初下跌，但公司的財報電話會議提供了更多供需細節，以及對2028財年的初步展望。
公司針對2028會計年度營收年增70%所提供的非正式財測，是許多分析師關注的亮點。如果不是受到供應限制，這項數字可能超過100%。這也促使分析師上調目標價，並開始期待這家半導體巨頭未來更多季度及年度的爆發式成長。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares rose 8.7% on Thursday the 27th after the company released its Q2 earnings and outlook, and the strong stock performance also boosted CEO Jensen Huang’s net worth.
Huang founded Nvidia in a Denny’s restaurant and helped build what is now the world’s most valuable company by market cap.
Nvidia’s stock closed Thursday at $227.98, near the historic high of $236.54.
According to Forbes, the Thursday price surge added roughly $14.9 billion to Huang’s wealth, making him the billionaire with the biggest single‑day gain that day.
The $14.9 billion increase lifted Huang’s net worth to $196.1 billion, a roughly 8.2% jump for the founder‑CEO who owns about 3% of the semiconductor giant.

With the higher net worth, Huang moved up to sixth place on Forbes’ billionaire list at $196.1 billion, overtaking Mark Zuckerberg’s $195.6 billion and Larry Ellison’s $193.6 billion; Zuckerberg’s wealth fell by $2.3 billion on Thursday while Ellison’s rose by $2.4 billion.
The only person ahead of Huang is Michael Dell, who ranked fifth and saw the second‑largest daily gain of $3.2 billion, bringing his total wealth to $243.4 billion.
Although Huang now edges slightly ahead of Zuckerberg and Ellison, he still trails Dell by more than $45 billion, so another rise could see his rank slip out of the global top ten.
Nvidia’s stock surge
Nvidia’s shares jumped sharply on Thursday as analysts and investors digested the company’s Q2 results and outlook.
After Nvidia reported its quarterly earnings on Wednesday, the stock initially fell, but the earnings call provided more supply‑demand details and an early outlook for fiscal 2028.

The informal guidance for fiscal 2028, which projects a 70% year‑over‑year revenue increase, was a key focus for many analysts; without supply constraints the figure could exceed 100%, prompting analysts to raise price targets and anticipate further explosive quarterly and annual growth from the semiconductor leader.

items.title: 華許傑克森霍爾首秀牽動美股 歷史數據透露哪些訊號？
items.title_en: Jerome Powell's Jackson Hole Debut Moves U.S. Stocks; Historical Data Shows What Signals?
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許週五 (28日) 將首次在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說。過去 3 年，標普 500 指數在 Fed 主席演說當天均上漲，但今年面臨通膨高於目標、美債殖利率攀升及政府債務膨脹等多重壓力，市場未必會再次給出正面反應。
數據顯示，自 2016 年以來的 10 次傑克森霍爾演說中，標普 500 有 70%的機率在當天上漲，一週後維持上漲的比率同樣為 70%；一個月後仍上漲的比率則降至 50%。
從平均報酬來看，演說當天標普 500 小跌 0.09%，一週後平均上漲 0.47%，一個月後平均下跌 0.55%。若改看中位數，三個期間則分別上漲 0.39%、0.54%及 0.22%，顯示市場多數時候反應溫和，但少數大跌年份明顯拖累整體平均表現。
2022年就是最鮮明的例子。時任 Fed 主席鮑爾當時以簡短而強硬的演說警告，為壓低通膨，企業與家庭可能必須承受經濟痛苦及就業損失。
標普 500 當天重挫 3.37%，一週後跌幅擴大至 3.29%，一個月後更累計下跌 9.92%，創近 10 年 Fed 主席傑克森霍爾演說後最差表現。
華許政策思路仍是謎
市場這次格外緊張，主要原因在於華爾街尚未摸清華許的政策思路。華許自 5 月接任 Fed 主席以來，主張央行應多聽取市場訊號、減少對外發言，並將通膨拉回 2%列為重要目標，卻未詳細說明具體路徑。
Columbia Threadneedle Investments首席投資組合策略師 Jason Vaillancourt表示，華許這場演說對市場影響重大，目前沒有人真正了解他制定政策時遵循的核心原則，也不確定他是否意識到市場迫切需要更明確的政策資訊。
華許不喜歡提供前瞻指引，發言風格也較為簡短，與鮑爾掌舵 Fed的8年形成明顯差異。標普 500 自兩週前創下歷史高點後走勢震盪，加上華許7月第二場記者會後美債遭到拋售，投資人擔心他的演說可能再度引發市場波動。
通膨、升息與債市三重壓力
目前 Fed主要通膨指標年增率達3.7%，仍遠高於2%目標。根據 CME FedWatch 工具，市場週四仍預期 Fed 9月會議維持利率不變，但對12月前升息一次的押注正在增加。
Fed如何讓通膨回落至2%的政策路徑仍不明朗，也是今年夏季美債賣壓升高的原因之一。30年期美債殖利率8月一度觸及2007年以來最高水準，10年期美債殖利率週四則徘徊在4.66%附近，雖略低於近期高點，仍明顯高於3月的約4%。
除了利率與通膨，華爾街也關注美國政府債務增至40兆美元，以及大型雲端業者為擴建AI基礎設施大量借款，對資金成本與債券供給造成的壓力。
隨著AI建設成為支撐美股的重要力量，債券殖利率上升也開始左右科技股及大盤走勢。
財政部與Fed會否互相牴觸？
財長貝森特計畫從9月起擴大回購長期美債，試圖改善債市狀況並降低借貸成本，但目前尚不清楚這項措施是否足以壓低殖利率。
Interactive Brokers首席策略師 Steve Sosnick表示，財政部的回購規模雖遠小於央行的債券購買計畫，仍可能對經濟產生刺激效果。在通膨尚未受控的情況下，這也引發財政部與Fed是否朝相反方向施力的疑問。
Sosnick預期，華許本次演說可能相當簡短，市場關心的許多問題未必能獲得答案。今年年會主題聚焦金融創新，華許也可能完全不談財政部近期介入債市的措施。對投資人而言，演說真正的風險可能不只是華許說了什麼，也包括他選擇不說什麼。
paras_en: Marketwatch reports that Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell will deliver his first speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting on Friday the 28th. Over the past three years, the S&P 500 has risen on the day of a Fed chair’s speech, but this year the market faces multiple pressures—inflation above target, rising U.S. Treasury yields and expanding government debt—so a positive reaction is not guaranteed.

Data show that in the ten Jackson Hole speeches since 2016, the S&P 500 has a 70% chance of gaining on the day of the speech, a 70% chance of staying up a week later, and a 50% chance of still being up a month later.

Looking at average returns, the S&P 500 fell 0.09% on speech day, rose an average of 0.47% a week later and slipped an average of 0.55% after a month. Using the median instead, the three periods show gains of 0.39%, 0.54% and 0.22% respectively, indicating that most of the time the market’s reaction is modest, but a few years with sharp drops pull down the overall average performance.
2022 is the clearest example. Then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell gave a brief but forceful warning that to bring inflation down, businesses and households might have to endure economic pain and job losses.
The S&P 500 plunged 3.37% that day, the loss widened to 3.29% a week later and deepened to a 9.92% decline after a month, the worst post‑Jackson Hole performance for a Fed chair in nearly a decade.
Powell’s policy direction remains a mystery

The market is especially nervous this time because Wall Street has not yet grasped Powell’s policy thinking. Since taking over in May, Powell has said the central bank should listen more to market signals, speak less publicly and make bringing inflation back to 2% a key goal, but he has not detailed the concrete path.

Jason Vaillancourt, chief portfolio strategist at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, said Powell’s speech will have a major market impact, yet no one truly understands the core principles he follows when setting policy, nor whether he realizes the market’s urgent need for clearer policy information.

Powell dislikes giving forward guidance and his speaking style is terse, a stark contrast to the eight years under former chair Jerome Powell. The S&P 500 has been choppy since hitting a historic high two weeks ago, and after Powell’s second press conference in July U.S. Treasuries were sold off, prompting investors to fear his speech could spark further market volatility.
Inflation, rate hikes and bond market pressure converge

Currently the Fed’s main inflation gauge is up 3.7% year‑over‑year, still well above the 2% target. According to the CME FedWatch tool, markets on Thursday still expect the Fed to hold rates steady at the September meeting, but bets on a rate hike before December are rising.

The policy path for bringing inflation back to 2% remains unclear, which is one reason summer U.S. bond‑selling pressure has intensified. The 30‑year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007 in August, while the 10‑year yield hovered around 4.66% on Thursday, slightly below recent peaks but still markedly above the roughly 4% seen in March.

Beyond rates and inflation, Wall Street is watching U.S. government debt swell to $40 trillion and large cloud providers borrowing heavily to expand AI infrastructure, adding pressure on funding costs and bond supply.
As AI construction becomes a key driver of U.S. equities, rising bond yields are also beginning to influence tech stocks and overall market direction.
Will the Treasury and the Fed clash?

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen plans to expand long‑term Treasury buybacks starting in September, aiming to improve bond market conditions and lower borrowing costs, though it is unclear whether the move will be enough to push yields down.

Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said that although the Treasury’s buyback scale is far smaller than the Fed’s bond‑purchase programs, it could still have a stimulative effect on the economy. With inflation still unchecked, this raises questions about whether the Treasury and the Fed are pulling in opposite directions.

Sosnick expects Powell’s speech to be fairly brief, and many of the market’s pressing questions may go unanswered. This year’s meeting focuses on financial innovation, and Powell may completely avoid discussing the Treasury’s recent bond‑market interventions. For investors, the real risk of the speech may lie not only in what Powell says, but also in what he chooses not to say.

items.title: 習近平訪美倒數 川普突暗示制裁「中國銀行」
items.title_en: Countdown to Xi Jinping's US Visit, Trump Hints at Sanctioning "Chinese Banks"
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美中官員正為中國國家主席習近平下月訪問華盛頓進行準備之際，美國總統川普週四 (27 日) 再度升高對北京的施壓力道，暗示不排除制裁協助伊朗石油交易的中國銀行。
川普週四向媒體表示，他「可能會制裁中國銀行」，並稱自己不必事先宣布所有措施。美國財長貝森特本週稍早也警告，若中國銀行參與將伊朗石油轉化為資金、進而支持伊朗政府的金融體系，就可能成為美方制裁目標。
儘管白宮對中措辭轉趨強硬，美中雙方仍持續推進高層互動。川普表示，習主席將在幾週後訪美，顯示兩國並未因伊朗制裁問題中斷元首會晤的準備工作。
美國駐中國大使龐德偉週三在北京會見中國外交部長王毅等官員，討論習近平即將對華盛頓進行的國是訪問。中國外交部發布的會談內容也提到，雙方將為下一階段的重要高層互動做好準備。
清華大學戰略與安全研究中心博士後研究員 Jodie Wen 表示，目前除了貝森特的警告之外，美方尚未公布具體制裁措施，因此現階段更像是一項警告。
她認為，川普與習近平今年 5 月會晤後，美中關係已轉向「可控競爭」，有別於拜登政府將中國視為戰略對手的定位。
中國對美國針對伊朗祭出的次級制裁，目前反應相對克制。北京僅表示將採取一切必要措施維護自身權益，但沒有說明可能採取哪些行動。中國外交部被問及是否曾就伊朗問題與美方溝通時，也表示沒有相關資訊可以提供，但證實兩國正討論川普與習近平會晤事宜。
布魯金斯學會中國中心主任 Ryan Hass 認為，由於美方在宣布制裁前並未進行充分鋪陳，北京可能將相關威脅視為政治表態，而非準備立即對中國大型金融機構採取行動。
Hass 指出，貝森特先前曾反問，為何美國要摧毀全球金融體系，北京可能據此判斷，華府不會對中國主要金融機構下手。他預估，美中貿易休戰仍將維持，因為關係再度惡化對雙方都更不利。
亞洲集團中國區董事總經理 Han Shen Lin 表示，中國目前的法律機制也為企業提供一定調整空間。中國企業的海外銀行可以遵守美國規定，但在中國境內仍須以中國法律為優先，使北京得以在維護自身利益的同時，有限度地配合美國制裁要求。
paras_en: CNBC reported that as U.S. and Chinese officials prepare for Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington next month, U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 27th) again stepped up pressure on Beijing, hinting that he would not rule out sanctioning Chinese banks that help facilitate Iran's oil transactions.

Trump told the media on Thursday that he "might sanction Chinese banks" and said he does not have to announce every measure in advance. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen earlier this week also warned that Chinese banks that turn Iranian oil into cash and thereby support Iran's government could become targets of U.S. sanctions.

Even as the White House’s language toward China has grown tougher, high‑level contacts between the two sides continue. Trump said President Xi will visit the United States in a few weeks, indicating that the two countries have not halted preparations for a summit despite the Iran‑sanctions issue.

U.S. Ambassador to China R. Nicholas Burns met on Wednesday in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials to discuss Xi’s upcoming state visit to Washington. The Chinese foreign ministry’s statement on the talks also said the sides will prepare for the next stage of important senior‑level interactions.

Jodie Wen, a post‑doctoral researcher at Tsinghua University’s Center for Strategic and Security Studies, said that aside from Yellen’s warning, the United States has not yet announced any concrete sanction measures, so at this stage it is more of a warning.

She believes that after Trump’s May meeting with Xi, U.S.–China relations have shifted to a "managed competition" model, different from the Biden administration’s view of China as a strategic adversary.

China’s response to the U.S. secondary sanctions on Iran has been relatively restrained. Beijing said it would take all necessary measures to protect its own interests but did not specify what actions might be taken. When asked if it had communicated with the U.S. on the Iran issue, the Chinese foreign ministry said it had no relevant information to share, but confirmed that the two countries are discussing the Trump‑Xi meeting.

Ryan Hass, director of the Brookings Institution’s China Center, said that because the U.S. has not laid out a full narrative before announcing sanctions, Beijing may view the threat as a political statement rather than an imminent move against its large financial institutions.

Hass noted that Yellen had previously asked why the United States would want to destroy the global financial system, and Beijing might infer from that that Washington will not target China’s major banks. He predicts the U.S.–China trade truce will hold, as a further deterioration would hurt both sides.

Han Shen Lin, managing director for Asia at a major Chinese conglomerate, said China’s legal framework gives companies some leeway. Overseas Chinese banks can comply with U.S. rules, but within China they must prioritize Chinese law, allowing Beijing to protect its interests while only partially accommodating U.S. sanction demands.

items.title: 美國號召G20寬鬆監管AI 馬斯克、黃仁勳、奧特曼將出席
items.title_en: US Calls for G20 to Adopt Looser AI Regulation, Musk, Jensen Huang and Altman to Attend
paras: 路透社引述消息人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳與OpenAI 執行長奧特曼預定下周出席在美國北卡羅來納州羅利舉行、聚焦科技議題的二十國集團（G20）部長級會議。
白宮科技顧問克拉茨歐斯（MichaelKratsios）的發言人表示，美國也安排SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克、Meta平台(META-US) 總裁麥考米克（DinaPowell McCormick），以及創投家兼前白宮AI顧問塞克斯（David Sacks），透過視訊連線向與會人士發表演說。據悉，相關演說將於9月1日登場。
一名白宮官員表示，美國將力促 G20 成員國簽署一項不具約束力的協議，主張以較寬鬆的方式監管 AI。該協議將呼籲各國避免成立新的監管機構，並與民間企業合作測試新興技術。
克拉茨歐斯在聲明中表示：「我們期待就更明智的監管方式、降低AI應用門檻，以及強化勞動力發展計畫進行深入討論，這些措施將推動全球經濟繁榮。」
OpenAI發言人表示，奧特曼將與美國商務部長盧特尼克進行爐邊對談，討論 AI 技術即將迎來的發展。黃仁勳的發言人則拒絕評論其出席安排。
此次會議是未來數月一系列 G20 相關會議之一，為今年 12 月在邁阿密舉行的 G20 領袖峰會預作準備。今年 G20 由美國擔任主席國。根據活動網站，成員國的科技與商務官員將在羅利會議上討論「AI 與其他新興科技」。
paras_en: Reuters, citing sources, reported that NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are scheduled to attend next week’s G20 ministerial meeting in Raleigh, North Carolina, which will focus on technology issues.

A spokesperson for White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios said the United States has also arranged for SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk, Meta Platforms (META-US) President Dina Powell McCormick, and venture capitalist and former White House AI adviser David Sacks to deliver remarks via video link, with the speeches slated for September 1.

A White House official said the United States will push G20 members to sign a non‑binding agreement advocating a more relaxed approach to AI regulation, urging countries to avoid creating new regulatory bodies and to work with private firms to test emerging technologies.

Kratos said in the statement, “We look forward to in‑depth discussions on smarter regulation, lowering the barriers to AI adoption, and strengthening workforce development programs, measures that will drive global economic prosperity.”

An OpenAI spokesperson said Altman will have a fireside chat with U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo to discuss the imminent developments in AI technology, while Huang’s spokesperson declined to comment on his attendance plans.

The meeting is one of a series of G20‑related gatherings in the coming months, preparing for the G20 Leaders’ Summit in Miami this December. The United States chairs this year’s G20, and according to the event website, technology and commerce officials from member states will discuss “AI and other emerging technologies” at the Raleigh meeting.

items.title: 美國防部封殺Anthropic踢鐵板 法院裁定「違法」
items.title_en: U.S. Defense Department Blacklists Anthropic, Court Rules It Illegal
paras: 美國加州聯邦法院週四 (27 日) 裁定，五角大廈將人工智慧公司 Anthropic 列為國家安全供應鏈風險，不僅侵犯其言論自由，也違反正當法律程序，因此判定這項決定「違法」。
美國聯邦地區法院法官 Rita Lin 撤銷 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險認定，並要求美國國防部收回所有針對該公司發布的指引、命令、通知及相關通訊。
Lin 在長達 59 頁的裁決中指出，五角大廈的決定「違法且毫無根據」。她表示，川普政府不能僅以國家安全為由，懲罰或報復批評政府政策的企業；憲法及國防部援引的聯邦法規，也不允許政府主要因 Anthropic 批評其 AI 使用政策，便對公司施加廣泛限制。
這場爭議源於 Anthropic 與國防部對 Claude 軍事用途的分歧。
Anthropic 拒絕允許美軍將 Claude 用於監控美國民眾或自主武器，主張現有 AI 模型的可靠程度仍不足以安全投入自主武器，國內監控也可能侵害民眾權利。
國防部則認為，私人企業不應限制軍方如何運用 AI。雙方協商破裂後，國防部今年 3 月將 Anthropic 列為供應鏈風險，禁止國防承包商在執行五角大廈業務時使用該公司的技術。
這是美國政府首次依據一項原本用於防範外國勢力滲透或破壞軍事系統的採購法規，公開將一家美國企業列為供應鏈風險。Anthropic 高層先前表示，這項認定可能造成公司數十億美元的業務損失，並損害其市場聲譽。
Anthropic 隨後於 3 月 9 日提起訴訟，指控國防長赫格塞斯越權，並因公司公開表達對戰場 AI 安全的看法而進行報復。公司也主張，政府在作出認定前，並未給予其提出異議的機會。
司法部則辯稱，這項認定源於 Anthropic 拒絕接受新的合約條款，而非公司對 AI 安全的立場。政府表示，Anthropic 對 Claude 設下使用限制，可能讓五角大廈無法確定軍方可如何運用該模型，並增加軍事行動期間系統遭停用的風險。
Anthropic 對此裁決表示欣慰。公司發言人聲明提到，Anthropic 將繼續與政府合作，運用 AI 強化美國國家安全，讓所有美國人都能從這項技術中受益。
不過，這項裁決尚未完全終結雙方的法律爭端。
Anthropic 仍在華盛頓特區進行另一宗相關訴訟，挑戰五角大廈依據不同法源作出的另一項供應鏈風險認定。若該項認定成立，Anthropic 仍可能遭排除於政府民用部門合約之外。
paras_en: A federal court in California ruled on Thursday (the 27th) that the Pentagon’s designation of artificial‑intelligence company Anthropic as a national‑security supply‑chain risk infringes its free‑speech rights and violates due process, deeming the decision illegal.

U.S. District Judge Rita Lin overturned Anthropic’s supply‑chain risk designation and ordered the Department of Defense to withdraw all guidance, orders, notices and related communications issued against the company.

In a 59‑page opinion, Lin said the Pentagon’s action was “illegal and baseless.” She noted that the Trump administration could not punish or retaliate against companies that criticize government policy on the grounds of national security, and that neither the Constitution nor the federal statutes cited by the DoD permit the government to impose sweeping restrictions simply because Anthropic criticized its AI‑use policies.
The dispute stems from a disagreement between Anthropic and the Defense Department over the military use of Anthropic’s Claude model.

Anthropic refused to allow the U.S. military to use Claude for domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons, arguing that current AI models are not reliable enough for safe deployment in autonomous weapons and that domestic monitoring could violate citizens’ rights.

The Defense Department countered that private firms should not limit how the military employs AI. After negotiations broke down, the Pentagon listed Anthropic as a supply‑chain risk in March, barring defense contractors from using its technology on Pentagon projects.

This marks the first time the U.S. government has publicly designated a domestic company as a supply‑chain risk under a procurement rule originally intended to guard against foreign infiltration or sabotage of military systems. Anthropic’s executives warned that the designation could cost the company billions of dollars in business and damage its reputation.

Anthropic filed a lawsuit on March 9, accusing Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin of overstepping his authority and retaliating for the company’s public statements on battlefield‑AI safety. The firm also argued that it was not given an opportunity to contest the designation before it was made.

The Justice Department argued that the designation resulted from Anthropic’s refusal to accept new contract terms, not from its stance on AI safety. The government said Anthropic’s usage restrictions on Claude made it difficult for the Pentagon to determine how the military could employ the model and increased the risk of the system being shut down during operations.

Anthropic welcomed the ruling. A company spokesperson said Anthropic will continue to work with the government to use AI to strengthen U.S. national security and ensure that all Americans benefit from the technology.
However, the decision does not fully resolve the legal battle between the parties.

Anthropic is also pursuing a separate lawsuit in Washington, D.C., challenging another supply‑chain risk designation the Pentagon made under a different legal authority. If that designation is upheld, Anthropic could still be excluded from civilian‑government contracts.

items.title: 「股神」巴菲特週日迎96歲生日 加碼Alphabet、擴大庫藏股仍難追上大盤
items.title_en: "Oracle of Omaha" Buffett Turns 96 on Sunday, Boosts Alphabet Stake and Expands Share Buybacks Yet Still Lags the Market
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，「股神」巴菲特即將在本週日 (30日) 迎接96歲生日，雖然他今年初卸下波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 執行長職務，但並未淡出公司決策，仍以董事長身分主導股票投資與庫藏股計畫。不過，波克夏今年股價幾乎原地踏步，明顯落後標普500指數13%的漲幅，成為交棒後最受關注的問題。波
卸任執行長後仍深度參與決策
巴菲特掌舵波克夏60年後，今年初將執行長職務交給阿貝爾 (Greg Abel)。過去8個月來，他仍每天前往奧馬哈辦公室、密切追蹤金融市場，並將工作重心放在自己最熟悉的投資與資本配置。
阿貝爾則負責管理波克夏旗下數十個營運部門，包括BNSF鐵路與大型電力事業。
CFRA分析師Cathy Seifert認為，巴菲特為阿貝爾留下穩健的公司基礎，兩人的能力也具有互補性。
不過，巴菲特今年年中曾摔斷腿，視力也持續惡化，已難以閱讀，顯示他的工作步調正逐漸放緩。
主導加碼Alphabet與擴大庫藏股
巴菲特卸任後最受矚目的投資，是波克夏持有的Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 部位。這筆投資始於2025年第三季，目前規模已增至350億美元，其中包括今年6月直接向Alphabet購入的100億美元股票。
Alphabet目前與可口可樂 (KO-US) 並列波克夏第三大股票投資，僅次於蘋果 (AAPL-US) 和美國運通 (AXP-US)。不過，波克夏最近一次加碼前，Alphabet股價已在16個月內上漲一倍，最新購入的100億美元部位目前略有虧損。
巴菲特也與阿貝爾共同決定擴大庫藏股。波克夏4月初至7月底買回近80億美元自家股票，成為公司歷來最積極的買回時期之一，遠高於第一季約2億美元。
以波克夏約1.1兆美元市值及股票流動性估算，公司每年有能力買回500億美元以上股票，相當於約5%市值。市場接下來將觀察，公司第三季是否繼續加速買回。
波克夏股價落後大盤
波克夏 (BRK.B-US) 週四小跌0.24%，收在503.70美元，今年以來股價僅小漲 1.38%，公司市值約1.08兆美元，股價較52週高點537.74美元低約6.3%，但仍較52週低點464.01美元高約8.6%。
儘管巴菲特仍積極參與決策，波克夏股價今年以來大致持平，A股約報75.3萬美元，B股約503美元；同期標普500指數累計上漲13%。波克夏的表現也落後保險、工業、鐵路和公用事業等相關類股。
股價落後的確切原因尚不明確。部分投資人可能仍在觀察阿貝爾接任後的表現，也可能對公司未更積極運用龐大現金感到失望。截至第二季末，波克夏持有3650億美元現金，且公司仍拒絕發放股息。
現金龐大但大型收購難尋
波克夏第二季買進230億美元股票，7月完成85億美元收購房屋建商Taylor Morrison，並於今年稍早斥資約20億美元投資日本保險公司東京海上。相關交易雖然降低部分現金部位，但波克夏每年稅後營業利益接近500億美元，現金仍會持續累積。
巴菲特一直希望完成規模可能達1000億美元以上的「大象級收購」，但波克夏堅持價格紀律，也不參與企業競標，使大型交易始終難以成形。聯合太平洋鐵路2025年7月同意收購諾福克南方後，波克夏也未進一步追求收購CSX。
投資團隊縮編引發接班疑問
波克夏投資團隊的安排同樣受到市場關注。長期投資經理Todd Combs去年12月轉往摩根大通後，巴菲特與阿貝爾並未補充人手。
目前Ted Weschler約管理波克夏超過3500億美元股票投資組合中的6%，整體投資組合則由阿貝爾監督。阿貝爾今年似乎尚未買進任何股票，反而出售約150億美元持股，包括原先由Combs管理的Visa (V-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)。
巴菲特約15年前延攬Weschler與Combs時，原先設想兩人未來共同管理整體投資組合，但之後似乎改變了安排。阿貝爾目前的做法也顯示，波克夏未來可能不再像巴菲特時代一樣，高度倚賴股票投資創造額外價值。
安排捐出持股但未告別投資
巴菲特上個月表示，計劃在2034年前捐出自己持有的全部波克夏股票。這筆約占公司13%的持股價值超過1400億美元，他希望三名逐漸年長的子女能在未來8年內親自完成捐贈。
即使已卸下執行長職務、著手安排捐出持股，巴菲特仍未離開股票市場。從1942年首次買進股票至今已過84年，他依然參與波克夏的重要投資與資本配置決策。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that "Oracle of Omaha" Warren Buffett will celebrate his 96th birthday this Sunday (the 30th). Although he stepped down as chief executive of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) earlier this year, he has not withdrawn from corporate decision‑making and continues to lead stock investing and the share‑repurchase program as chairman. Yet Berkshire’s stock has been essentially flat this year, lagging the S&P 500’s 13% gain and becoming the most watched issue since the leadership hand‑off.
After stepping down as CEO, Buffett remains deeply involved in decisions

After steering Berkshire for six decades, Buffett handed the CEO role to Greg Abel at the start of the year. Over the past eight months he still goes to the Omaha office daily, closely monitors the financial markets, and focuses his effort on the investments and capital allocation he knows best.
Abel is responsible for managing Berkshire’s dozens of operating subsidiaries, including BNSF Railway and large‑scale power businesses.
CFRA analyst Cathy Seifert says Buffett has left a solid corporate foundation for Abel, and the two executives have complementary strengths.
However, Buffett suffered a broken leg in mid‑year and his vision continues to deteriorate, making reading difficult and indicating his work pace is slowing.
He leads the increased stake in Alphabet and the expanded share‑buyback

The most closely watched investment since Buffett’s CEO exit is Berkshire’s holding in Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). The stake, initiated in the third quarter of 2025, has grown to $35 billion, including a $10 billion purchase directly from Alphabet in June this year.

Alphabet now ties with Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) as Berkshire’s third‑largest stock holding, behind Apple (AAPL‑US) and American Express (AXP‑US). Yet before the latest addition, Alphabet’s share price had already doubled over the prior 16 months, and the newly bought $10 billion position is presently slightly underwater.

Buffett and Abel also agreed to expand the share‑repurchase program. From early April to the end of July Berkshire bought back nearly $8 billion of its own stock, marking one of the most aggressive buyback periods in the company’s history, far exceeding the roughly $200 million repurchased in the first quarter.

Based on Berkshire’s roughly $1.1 trillion market value and stock liquidity, the firm can repurchase more than $50 billion of shares each year, about 5% of its market cap. The market will watch whether the company accelerates buybacks in the third quarter.
Berkshire’s stock lags the market

Berkshire (BRK.B‑US) slipped 0.24% on Thursday to close at $503.70, up just 1.38% year‑to‑date. The company’s market value is about $1.08 trillion; the price is roughly 6.3% below its 52‑week high of $537.74 but about 8.6% above its 52‑week low of $464.01.

Even though Buffett remains active in decision‑making, Berkshire’s stock has been essentially flat this year, with class A shares around $75,300 and class B at $503; over the same period the S&P 500 has risen 13%. Berkshire’s performance also trails related sectors such as insurance, industrials, railroads and utilities.

The exact cause of the lag is unclear. Some investors may still be watching Abel’s performance after the hand‑off, while others may be disappointed that the firm has not deployed its massive cash more aggressively. As of the end of the second quarter Berkshire held $365 billion in cash and still refuses to pay a dividend.
Huge cash but few large acquisitions

In the second quarter Berkshire bought $23 billion of its own stock, completed an $8.5 billion acquisition of home‑builder Taylor Morrison in July, and earlier in the year invested about $2 billion in Japan’s insurer Tokio Marine. While those deals trimmed cash, Berkshire’s after‑tax operating earnings are near $50 billion annually, so cash will keep accumulating.

Buffett has long hoped to execute a “mega‑elephant” acquisition that could exceed $100 billion, but Berkshire’s strict price discipline and avoidance of competitive bidding have kept such deals from materialising. After Union Pacific agreed in July 2025 to buy Norfolk Southern, Berkshire did not pursue a bid for CSX.
Investment team cuts raise succession questions
The composition of Berkshire’s investment team also draws market attention. After long‑term manager Todd Combs moved to JPMorgan in December, Buffett and Abel have not filled the vacancy.

Currently Ted Weschler oversees about 6% of Berkshire’s more than $350 billion of equity holdings, with the overall portfolio supervised by Abel. Abel appears to have bought no new stocks this year, instead selling roughly $15 billion of holdings, including Visa (V‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) that were previously managed by Combs.

When Buffett recruited Weschler and Combs about 15 years ago, the original plan was for the two to jointly manage the entire portfolio, but that arrangement seems to have changed. Abel’s current approach also suggests Berkshire may no longer rely on stock investing to generate extra value to the extent it did under Buffett’s era.
Arranging to donate holdings without exiting investing

Last month Buffett said he plans to donate all of his Berkshire shares before 2034. The stake, about 13% of the company and valued at over $140 billion, is intended to be given by his three aging children over the next eight years.

Even after stepping down as CEO and arranging the eventual donation of his stake, Buffett has not left the stock market. From his first purchase in 1942 to today, 84 years later, he still participates in Berkshire’s key investment and capital‑allocation decisions.

items.title: 輝達財報會議透露SpaceX三大訊號
items.title_en: Nvidia Earnings Call Reveals Three SpaceX Signals
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，投資人聆聽輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)財報電話會議，也從中獲得了一些有關SpaceX(SPCX-US)的資訊，足以推升這家由馬斯克(Elon Musk)執掌的火箭與AI公司股價。
輝達周三公布優於預期的財報及強勁財測後，股價周四(27日)上漲8.7%。這也帶動那斯達克綜合指數上漲1.6%。SpaceX股價上漲0.9%，收於140.87美元。標普500指數與道瓊工業平均指數分別上漲0.7%及0.2%。
SpaceX在輝達的財報電話會議中被提及。財務長Colette Kress表示，「我們預期每一家主要超大規模雲端服務商、新型雲端服務商、AI實驗室及系統OEM廠商都將部署Vera，目前已開始向包括甲骨文、SpaceX AI在內的主要合作夥伴出貨，而亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services)也將從本季開始收到出貨。」
Vera是輝達更新版的資料中心CPU，專注於改善AI代理工作負載，也就是處理超越單純在聊天機器人輸入提示詞的AI工作。
Kress補充，SpaceX最近收購的Cursor，年度經常性收入(ARR)已達到10億美元。這是華爾街最喜歡用來描述AI銷售成長的指標之一。以目前的業務規模來看，Cursor的年營收將超過10億美元。當然，ARR理應持續成長。根據報導，Anthropic的ARR最近已達650億美元。
另外，Kress也提到SpaceX的AI模型Grok。她表示，「輝達支援領先的閉源模型，包括OpenAI、Anthropic、Grok、Meta、Gemini，以及領先的開源模型，包括TML、Mistral、Qwen、Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Minimax及Nemotron。」
作為領先的AI模型固然很好，但隨著AI持續發展，市場也持續出現新的模型。閉源模型是在供應商的伺服器上透過雲端存取，客製化程度有限。開源模型則可以部署在任何伺服器上，有助於提升資料隱私，且可以完全客製化。
輝達財報對包括SpaceX在內的整個市場都相當重要。該公司晶片推動了AI運算熱潮，而SpaceX正試圖將這股熱潮轉化為價值數兆美元的業務。
SpaceX在2025年的AI營收為32億美元。根據華爾街預估，這項數字到2027年可能突破600億美元。
對輝達有利的事情，最終也有利於SpaceX。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that investors listening to Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings call also gleaned information about SpaceX (SPCX-US), enough to boost the stock of Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company.

After Nvidia posted better‑than‑expected earnings and strong guidance on Wednesday, its shares rose 8.7% on Thursday the 27th, lifting the Nasdaq Composite 1.6%. SpaceX shares rose 0.9% to $140.87. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.7% and 0.2% respectively.

SpaceX was mentioned during Nvidia’s earnings call. CFO Colette Kress said, “We expect every major hyperscale cloud provider, next‑gen cloud provider, AI lab and system OEM to deploy Vera; shipments have already begun to key partners including Oracle, SpaceX AI, and Amazon Web Services will start receiving shipments this quarter.”
Vera is Nvidia’s next‑generation data‑center CPU, focused on improving AI‑agent workloads – AI tasks that go beyond simple prompt‑based chatbot inputs.

Kress added that SpaceX’s recent acquisition, Cursor, now has annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $1 billion, a metric Wall Street loves for measuring AI sales growth. At its current scale, Cursor’s annual revenue will exceed $1 billion and ARR should keep growing. By comparison, Anthropic’s ARR has recently reached $65 billion.

She also referenced SpaceX’s AI model Grok, stating, “Nvidia supports leading closed‑source models including OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, Meta, Gemini, as well as leading open‑source models such as TML, Mistral, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Minimax and Nemotron.”

While leading AI models are valuable, the market continuously sees new models as AI evolves. Closed‑source models run on vendor servers accessed via the cloud and offer limited customization. Open‑source models can be deployed on any server, enhancing data privacy and allowing full customization.

Nvidia’s earnings are highly significant for the broader market, including SpaceX. Its chips have driven the AI computing boom, and SpaceX is trying to turn that momentum into a multi‑trillion‑dollar business.
SpaceX’s AI revenue is projected at $3.2 billion for 2025, and Wall Street estimates it could exceed $60 billion by 2027.
Things that benefit Nvidia ultimately also benefit SpaceX.

items.title: AI需求未到頂？輝達2028財年70%成長展望震撼華爾街 16家券商上調目標價 最高喊390美元
items.title_en: Is AI Demand Yet to Peak? Nvidia Forecasts 70% Revenue Growth for FY2028, Shocking Wall Street; 16 Brokers Raise Targets, Highest at $390
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)公布優於市場預期的2027會計年度第2季財報，並罕見對尚未開始的2028會計年度給出約70%的營收成長展望後，華爾街分析師紛紛上調目標價。市場認為，這份長期指引不僅大幅超越原先約45%的市場共識，也顯示AI基礎設施投資熱潮仍具延續性，不過高階記憶體供應緊張與成本上升，將成為輝達未來幾季毛利率面臨的主要壓力。
輝達截至7月26日的2027會計年度第2季營收達962.21億美元，季增18%、年增106%，優於市場預期；GAAP每股盈餘為2.46美元，年增128%，調整後每股盈餘為2.22美元，年增120%。資料中心營收達890億美元，季增18%、年增117%，持續成為推動整體業績成長的最大動能。GAAP與調整後毛利率均為75%。
展望第3季，輝達預估營收將達1,080億美元，上下浮動2%，高於市場原先約1,041.9億美元的預期，且這項展望並未假設來自中國的資料中心運算營收。公司預估GAAP與調整後毛利率均為74%，上下浮動50個基點，GAAP營運費用約92億美元，調整後營運費用約90億美元。
更令市場振奮的是，輝達管理層首次對仍約5個月後才開始的完整2028會計年度提供較明確的早期展望，預計全年營收可望成長約70%。這項數字遠高於市場原先約45%的共識預期，也成為分析師集體調高目標價的主要原因。路透報導指出，公司同時警告，高階記憶體供應短缺仍將限制其擴大產能與滿足全部需求的速度。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson重申對輝達的「優於大盤」評級，並將目標價從330美元調高至345美元。他表示，輝達最新指引讓市場獲得「一整年的可見度」，不僅第3季展望優於預期，對2028會計年度約70%的營收成長預估也遠超市場想像。
Bryson指出，輝達將2028會計年度的營收前景描述為「受供應限制」，意味實際需求可能比公司公布的指引更強。他認為，供應瓶頸使輝達無法實現營收翻倍，而記憶體成本上升也將壓低未來毛利率。從公司提高系統與解決方案價格、但毛利率仍然下降的情況來看，輝達似乎正在自行吸收部分記憶體成本漲幅，而非將所有成本完全轉嫁給客戶。
Rosenblatt分析師Kevin Cassidy則重申「買進」評級，並將目標價從325美元大幅上調至390美元，為上述分析師中最高。他將這次財報與展望形容為「輝達的第二個重要時刻」，認為公司即使在供應受限的情況下，仍給出2028會計年度營收年增約70%的預期，已大幅超越市場約45%的共識。
Cassidy表示，若沒有供應限制，輝達2028會計年度的營收成長潛力甚至可能接近100%。他認為，公司短期吸收部分記憶體漲價將對毛利率造成壓力，但利用雄厚的資產負債表提前確保供應，也形成另一道重要競爭護城河。
他並強調，輝達本季創下歷史新高營收，資料中心業務年增117%。隨著AI雲端、主權AI及企業採用持續擴大，Cassidy預期公司所謂的AI Cloud Infrastructure and Enterprise(ACIE)業務長期成長速度可望快於大型雲端服務供應商客戶。
KeyBanc分析師John Vinh則維持「加碼」評級與330美元目標價。他形容輝達第2季業績表現強勁，第3季展望也明顯優於市場預期。此外，管理層提到的營收分成融資模式同樣受到市場關注，該模式可提供take-or-pay(照付不議)承諾，進一步提高未來營收的可預見性。
DA Davidson分析師Gil Luria重申「買進」評級，目標價維持300美元。他表示，輝達的新指引提供「前所未有的可見度」，尤其是公司首次提出2028會計年度約70%的全年營收成長框架，雖然這項預估仍受到供應限制。
Luria認為，市場接下來應特別關注毛利率走勢。他預估，輝達毛利率可能在第4季降至71.5%，隨後在2028會計年度回穩至72.5%。他指出，幾乎所有毛利率壓力都來自記憶體價格上漲，輝達選擇自行吸收部分成本，主要是因為若將成本全部轉嫁給客戶，最終產品定價可能高到影響客戶的投資回報。
Benchmark分析師Cody Acree則重申「買進」評級與335美元目標價。他指出，輝達公布第2季財報後，股價一度走低，但在電話會議與管理層提出遠高於預期的2028會計年度營收展望後迅速反轉，盤後一度上漲約5%。
Acree估算，若2028會計年度營收成長70%，將意味全年營收約達6,900億美元，遠高於華爾街原先約5,735億美元的共識。他認為，即使輝達的單季營收基數已接近1,000億美元，市場需求訊號與公司受供應能力限制所給出的營收指引之間，仍存在龐大差距，這將為未來持續上調財測留下空間。
Acree坦言，最新財報中較偏負面的部分是毛利率指引，但他認為，犧牲部分利潤率有助於改善客戶的經濟效益並提高供應轉換效率，而更高的營收規模仍將實質推升2028會計年度每股盈餘。他也認為，相較同業與新財年框架所提供的營運可見度，輝達目前估值仍偏保守，因此股價仍有進一步上漲空間。
除了分析師正面解讀外，輝達的長期展望也帶動整體AI與半導體類股走高。路透報導指出，輝達樂觀的營收預測緩解市場對大型科技公司資料中心資本支出可能放緩的疑慮，公司股價27日終場大漲8.7%，至少已有16家券商在財報後上調其目標價，其他晶片與記憶體類股也受到帶動。

市場另一個關注焦點則是輝達下一代Vera Rubin平台。公司表示，Vera Rubin已開始全面量產，合作夥伴包括CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Google Cloud、Microsoft(MSFT-US) Azure、Oracle(ORCL-US) Cloud Infrastructure及Nebius(NBIS-US)等平台均開始導入相關機櫃系統。這也進一步降低市場先前對下一代產品推出時程可能延後的疑慮。
輝達創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳則表示，AI已進入新的轉折點，運算能力正從單純的技術投資逐漸轉化為可直接創造收入的生產工具。他指出，市場需求不再只由少數大型AI實驗室推動，目前已有更多前沿AI實驗室、新創公司、開源模型生態系與實體AI應用同步擴張，全球AI基礎設施建設仍處於全速推進階段。
在供應面上，高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及其他高階記憶體零組件短缺，仍是輝達未來營收成長的主要限制。分析師普遍認為，這也解釋了為何公司即使面臨旺盛需求，仍未給出更高的營收成長率，同時選擇吸收部分成本以維持客戶採購的經濟效益。

截至27日美股收盤，輝達股價大漲8.69%，收在227.81美元，盤中與52周高點236.54美元進一步拉近距離；其52周交易區間為164.07美元至236.54美元。2026年以來，輝達股價累計上漲20.7%。在強勁財報、優於預期的短期展望及2028會計年度約70%的成長框架支撐下，華爾街目前的討論焦點已從AI需求是否減速，逐漸轉向輝達能否取得足夠的記憶體與其他關鍵零組件，以滿足遠超現有供應能力的龐大需求。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) reported a second‑quarter FY2027 earnings beat and, unusually, gave a roughly 70% revenue growth outlook for the not‑yet‑started FY2028, prompting Wall Street analysts to lift their price targets. The market sees this long‑term guidance as far above the roughly 45% consensus and a sign that AI infrastructure spending remains robust, though tight high‑end memory supply and rising costs will pressure Nvidia’s margins in coming quarters.

For the FY2027 second quarter ending July 26, Nvidia posted $96.221 billion in revenue, up 18% sequentially and 106% year‑over‑year, beating expectations; GAAP EPS was $2.46, up 128% YoY, and adjusted EPS was $2.22, up 120% YoY. Data‑center revenue reached $89.0 billion, up 18% sequentially and 117% YoY, remaining the chief driver of overall growth. Both GAAP and adjusted gross margins were 75%.

Looking ahead to Q3, Nvidia expects revenue of about $108 billion, give or take 2%, above the prior market estimate of roughly $104.19 billion, and this outlook excludes any data‑center revenue from China. The company projects GAAP and adjusted gross margins of 74% ± 50 basis points, GAAP operating expenses of about $9.2 billion and adjusted operating expenses of roughly $9.0 billion.

More market excitement came as Nvidia’s management offered, for the first time, a clearer early view of the full FY2028 that starts in about five months, forecasting roughly 70% full‑year revenue growth. This figure far exceeds the prior consensus of about 45% and is the main reason analysts collectively raised their targets. Reuters noted the company also warned that high‑end memory shortages will continue to limit capacity expansion and the speed of meeting total demand.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson reiterated his “outperform” rating on Nvidia and raised his price target from $330 to $345. He said the new guidance gives the market “a full year of visibility,” with a Q3 outlook that beats expectations and a FY2028 revenue growth estimate of about 70% that far surpasses market imagination.

Bryson pointed out that Nvidia described the FY2028 revenue outlook as “supply‑constrained,” implying actual demand could be stronger than the guidance. He believes supply bottlenecks prevent a revenue doubling, and rising memory costs will depress future margins. From Nvidia’s move to raise system and solution prices while margins still fall, it appears the company is absorbing part of the memory cost increase rather than passing it all to customers.

Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy reaffirmed a “buy” rating and lifted his price target dramatically to $390, the highest among the cited analysts. He called the earnings release and outlook “Nvidia’s second pivotal moment,” noting that even with supply constraints the company still projects roughly 70% YoY revenue growth for FY2028, well above the roughly 45% market consensus.

Cassidy said that without supply constraints Nvidia’s FY2028 revenue growth potential could even approach 100%. He believes the short‑term absorption of some memory price hikes will pressure margins, but Nvidia’s strong balance sheet lets it secure supply early, creating another important competitive moat.

He also emphasized that Nvidia posted record‑high revenue this quarter, with data‑center sales up 117% YoY. As AI cloud, sovereign AI and enterprise adoption continue to expand, Cassidy expects the so‑called AI Cloud Infrastructure and Enterprise (ACIE) segment to grow faster over the long term than the large‑cloud service provider customers it serves.

KeyBanc analyst John Vinh kept a “overweight” rating with a $330 target, describing Nvidia’s Q2 performance as strong and the Q3 outlook clearly ahead of market expectations. He also noted that management’s mention of a revenue‑share financing model attracted market interest, as the model can provide take‑or‑pay commitments that further improve revenue visibility.

DA Davidson analyst Gil Luria reiterated a “buy” rating with a $300 target. He said Nvidia’s new guidance offers “unprecedented visibility,” especially the first‑time FY2028 framework of about 70% full‑year revenue growth, even though the estimate remains subject to supply limits.

Luria believes the market should watch margin trends closely. He forecasts Nvidia’s gross margin could dip to 71.5% in Q4 before stabilizing at 72.5% in FY2028. He noted that almost all margin pressure stems from rising memory prices, and Nvidia is choosing to absorb part of the cost because passing it all to customers could push product pricing to levels that hurt customers’ return on investment.

Benchmark analyst Cody Acree reiterated a “buy” rating with a $335 target. He observed that after Nvidia’s Q2 results, the stock fell briefly but quickly rebounded after the earnings call and management’s far‑above‑expectations FY2028 revenue outlook, jumping roughly 5% in after‑hours trading.

Acree estimated that a 70% FY2028 revenue increase would put full‑year revenue at about $690 billion, far above Wall Street’s prior consensus of roughly $573.5 billion. He said that even though Nvidia’s quarterly revenue base is nearing $100 billion, a large gap remains between market demand signals and the revenue guidance constrained by supply capacity, leaving room for further upward revisions.

Acree admitted the more negative aspect of the latest results is the margin guidance, but he believes sacrificing some margin helps improve customers’ economics and supply conversion efficiency, while the larger revenue scale will materially boost FY2028 EPS. He also feels Nvidia’s valuation is still conservative relative to peers and the visibility the new fiscal framework provides, leaving upside potential for the stock.

Beyond analyst optimism, Nvidia’s long‑term outlook lifted the broader AI and semiconductor sectors. Reuters reported that Nvidia’s upbeat revenue forecast eased concerns that large‑tech data‑center capex might slow, sending the stock up 8.7% on the 27th, with at least 16 brokerages raising their targets after the earnings release, and other chip and memory stocks also rallying.

Another market focus is Nvidia’s next‑generation Vera Rubin platform. The company said Vera Rubin is now in full‑scale production, with partners such as CoreWeave (CRWV-US), Google Cloud, Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure, Oracle (ORCL-US) Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius (NBIS-US) already integrating the related rack systems. This further allays earlier worries about a delayed launch of the next‑gen product.

Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang said AI has reached a new inflection point, with compute power shifting from pure technology investment to a revenue‑generating production tool. He noted demand is no longer driven solely by a few large AI labs; today many frontier labs, startups, open‑source model ecosystems and real‑world AI applications are expanding in tandem, keeping global AI infrastructure construction in full‑speed forward motion.

On the supply side, shortages of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other high‑end memory components remain the main constraint on Nvidia’s future revenue growth. Analysts generally agree this explains why the company, despite strong demand, has not issued a higher growth rate and is choosing to absorb part of the cost to preserve customers’ purchasing economics.

As of the close on the 27th, Nvidia’s shares surged 8.69% to $227.81, narrowing the gap to the 52‑week high of $236.54; the 52‑week range is $164.07 to $236.54. Since the start of 2026, the stock has risen 20.7% cumulatively. Backed by a robust earnings report, an above‑expectation short‑term outlook and a roughly 70% FY2028 growth framework, Wall Street’s conversation is shifting from whether AI demand is slowing to whether Nvidia can secure enough memory and other critical components to meet demand that far outstrips current supply capacity.

items.title: 黃仁勳身價一日暴增149億美元 超越祖克柏躍居全球第六
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Net Worth Jumps $14.9 B in One Day, Surpassing Zuckerberg to Rank Sixth Globally
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)股價周四(27日)上漲8.7%，此前公司公布第二季財報及財測。強勁的股價表現也推升了輝達執行長黃仁勳的身價。
黃仁勳曾在一家Denny"s餐廳內創辦輝達，並協助打造如今全球市值最高的公司。
輝達股價周四收於227.98美元，接近236.54美元的歷史新高。
根據《富比士》資料，隨著周四股價上漲，黃仁勳身價估計增加149億美元，按美元計算，成為當天所有億萬富豪中身價增加最多的人。
這149億美元的增幅，使黃仁勳身價升至1,961億美元。這位持有這家半導體巨頭約3%股份的創辦人兼執行長，身價單日大增8.2%。
隨著身價增加，黃仁勳在《富比士》億萬富豪榜上的排名升至第六名，身價達1,961億美元。周四，黃仁勳超越了祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)的1,956億美元與Larry Ellison的1,936億美元身價。祖克柏身價周四減少23億美元，而Ellison則增加24億美元。
排名在黃仁勳之前的是位居第五名的戴爾(Michael Dell)。戴爾是周四身價增加第二多的富豪，增加32億美元，使其總身價達2,434億美元。
如今黃仁勳的身價僅略高於祖克柏與Ellison，但仍落後戴爾超過450億美元，因此在再次向上攀升之前，他的排名更有可能跌出全球前十大富豪之列。
輝達股價飆升
輝達股價周四大漲，分析師與投資人正在消化公司第二季財報及財測。
輝達周三公布季度業績後，股價最初下跌，但公司的財報電話會議提供了更多供需細節，以及對2028財年的初步展望。
公司針對2028會計年度營收年增70%所提供的非正式財測，是許多分析師關注的亮點。如果不是受到供應限制，這項數字可能超過100%。這也促使分析師上調目標價，並開始期待這家半導體巨頭未來更多季度及年度的爆發式成長。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares rose 8.7% on Thursday the 27th after the company released its Q2 earnings and outlook, and the strong stock performance also boosted CEO Jensen Huang’s net worth.
Huang founded Nvidia in a Denny’s restaurant and helped build what is now the world’s most valuable company by market cap.
Nvidia’s stock closed Thursday at $227.98, near the historic high of $236.54.
According to Forbes, the Thursday price surge added roughly $14.9 billion to Huang’s wealth, making him the billionaire with the biggest single‑day gain that day.
The $14.9 billion increase lifted Huang’s net worth to $196.1 billion, a roughly 8.2% jump for the founder‑CEO who owns about 3% of the semiconductor giant.

With the higher net worth, Huang moved up to sixth place on Forbes’ billionaire list at $196.1 billion, overtaking Mark Zuckerberg’s $195.6 billion and Larry Ellison’s $193.6 billion; Zuckerberg’s wealth fell by $2.3 billion on Thursday while Ellison’s rose by $2.4 billion.
The only person ahead of Huang is Michael Dell, who ranked fifth and saw the second‑largest daily gain of $3.2 billion, bringing his total wealth to $243.4 billion.
Although Huang now edges slightly ahead of Zuckerberg and Ellison, he still trails Dell by more than $45 billion, so another rise could see his rank slip out of the global top ten.
Nvidia’s stock surge
Nvidia’s shares jumped sharply on Thursday as analysts and investors digested the company’s Q2 results and outlook.
After Nvidia reported its quarterly earnings on Wednesday, the stock initially fell, but the earnings call provided more supply‑demand details and an early outlook for fiscal 2028.

The informal guidance for fiscal 2028, which projects a 70% year‑over‑year revenue increase, was a key focus for many analysts; without supply constraints the figure could exceed 100%, prompting analysts to raise price targets and anticipate further explosive quarterly and annual growth from the semiconductor leader.

items.title: 華許傑克森霍爾首秀牽動美股 歷史數據透露哪些訊號？
items.title_en: Jerome Powell's Jackson Hole Debut Moves U.S. Stocks; Historical Data Shows What Signals?
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許週五 (28日) 將首次在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說。過去 3 年，標普 500 指數在 Fed 主席演說當天均上漲，但今年面臨通膨高於目標、美債殖利率攀升及政府債務膨脹等多重壓力，市場未必會再次給出正面反應。
數據顯示，自 2016 年以來的 10 次傑克森霍爾演說中，標普 500 有 70%的機率在當天上漲，一週後維持上漲的比率同樣為 70%；一個月後仍上漲的比率則降至 50%。
從平均報酬來看，演說當天標普 500 小跌 0.09%，一週後平均上漲 0.47%，一個月後平均下跌 0.55%。若改看中位數，三個期間則分別上漲 0.39%、0.54%及 0.22%，顯示市場多數時候反應溫和，但少數大跌年份明顯拖累整體平均表現。
2022年就是最鮮明的例子。時任 Fed 主席鮑爾當時以簡短而強硬的演說警告，為壓低通膨，企業與家庭可能必須承受經濟痛苦及就業損失。
標普 500 當天重挫 3.37%，一週後跌幅擴大至 3.29%，一個月後更累計下跌 9.92%，創近 10 年 Fed 主席傑克森霍爾演說後最差表現。
華許政策思路仍是謎
市場這次格外緊張，主要原因在於華爾街尚未摸清華許的政策思路。華許自 5 月接任 Fed 主席以來，主張央行應多聽取市場訊號、減少對外發言，並將通膨拉回 2%列為重要目標，卻未詳細說明具體路徑。
Columbia Threadneedle Investments首席投資組合策略師 Jason Vaillancourt表示，華許這場演說對市場影響重大，目前沒有人真正了解他制定政策時遵循的核心原則，也不確定他是否意識到市場迫切需要更明確的政策資訊。
華許不喜歡提供前瞻指引，發言風格也較為簡短，與鮑爾掌舵 Fed的8年形成明顯差異。標普 500 自兩週前創下歷史高點後走勢震盪，加上華許7月第二場記者會後美債遭到拋售，投資人擔心他的演說可能再度引發市場波動。
通膨、升息與債市三重壓力
目前 Fed主要通膨指標年增率達3.7%，仍遠高於2%目標。根據 CME FedWatch 工具，市場週四仍預期 Fed 9月會議維持利率不變，但對12月前升息一次的押注正在增加。
Fed如何讓通膨回落至2%的政策路徑仍不明朗，也是今年夏季美債賣壓升高的原因之一。30年期美債殖利率8月一度觸及2007年以來最高水準，10年期美債殖利率週四則徘徊在4.66%附近，雖略低於近期高點，仍明顯高於3月的約4%。
除了利率與通膨，華爾街也關注美國政府債務增至40兆美元，以及大型雲端業者為擴建AI基礎設施大量借款，對資金成本與債券供給造成的壓力。
隨著AI建設成為支撐美股的重要力量，債券殖利率上升也開始左右科技股及大盤走勢。
財政部與Fed會否互相牴觸？
財長貝森特計畫從9月起擴大回購長期美債，試圖改善債市狀況並降低借貸成本，但目前尚不清楚這項措施是否足以壓低殖利率。
Interactive Brokers首席策略師 Steve Sosnick表示，財政部的回購規模雖遠小於央行的債券購買計畫，仍可能對經濟產生刺激效果。在通膨尚未受控的情況下，這也引發財政部與Fed是否朝相反方向施力的疑問。
Sosnick預期，華許本次演說可能相當簡短，市場關心的許多問題未必能獲得答案。今年年會主題聚焦金融創新，華許也可能完全不談財政部近期介入債市的措施。對投資人而言，演說真正的風險可能不只是華許說了什麼，也包括他選擇不說什麼。
paras_en: Marketwatch reports that Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell will deliver his first speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting on Friday the 28th. Over the past three years, the S&P 500 has risen on the day of a Fed chair’s speech, but this year the market faces multiple pressures—inflation above target, rising U.S. Treasury yields and expanding government debt—so a positive reaction is not guaranteed.

Data show that in the ten Jackson Hole speeches since 2016, the S&P 500 has a 70% chance of gaining on the day of the speech, a 70% chance of staying up a week later, and a 50% chance of still being up a month later.

Looking at average returns, the S&P 500 fell 0.09% on speech day, rose an average of 0.47% a week later and slipped an average of 0.55% after a month. Using the median instead, the three periods show gains of 0.39%, 0.54% and 0.22% respectively, indicating that most of the time the market’s reaction is modest, but a few years with sharp drops pull down the overall average performance.
2022 is the clearest example. Then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell gave a brief but forceful warning that to bring inflation down, businesses and households might have to endure economic pain and job losses.
The S&P 500 plunged 3.37% that day, the loss widened to 3.29% a week later and deepened to a 9.92% decline after a month, the worst post‑Jackson Hole performance for a Fed chair in nearly a decade.
Powell’s policy direction remains a mystery

The market is especially nervous this time because Wall Street has not yet grasped Powell’s policy thinking. Since taking over in May, Powell has said the central bank should listen more to market signals, speak less publicly and make bringing inflation back to 2% a key goal, but he has not detailed the concrete path.

Jason Vaillancourt, chief portfolio strategist at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, said Powell’s speech will have a major market impact, yet no one truly understands the core principles he follows when setting policy, nor whether he realizes the market’s urgent need for clearer policy information.

Powell dislikes giving forward guidance and his speaking style is terse, a stark contrast to the eight years under former chair Jerome Powell. The S&P 500 has been choppy since hitting a historic high two weeks ago, and after Powell’s second press conference in July U.S. Treasuries were sold off, prompting investors to fear his speech could spark further market volatility.
Inflation, rate hikes and bond market pressure converge

Currently the Fed’s main inflation gauge is up 3.7% year‑over‑year, still well above the 2% target. According to the CME FedWatch tool, markets on Thursday still expect the Fed to hold rates steady at the September meeting, but bets on a rate hike before December are rising.

The policy path for bringing inflation back to 2% remains unclear, which is one reason summer U.S. bond‑selling pressure has intensified. The 30‑year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007 in August, while the 10‑year yield hovered around 4.66% on Thursday, slightly below recent peaks but still markedly above the roughly 4% seen in March.

Beyond rates and inflation, Wall Street is watching U.S. government debt swell to $40 trillion and large cloud providers borrowing heavily to expand AI infrastructure, adding pressure on funding costs and bond supply.
As AI construction becomes a key driver of U.S. equities, rising bond yields are also beginning to influence tech stocks and overall market direction.
Will the Treasury and the Fed clash?

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen plans to expand long‑term Treasury buybacks starting in September, aiming to improve bond market conditions and lower borrowing costs, though it is unclear whether the move will be enough to push yields down.

Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said that although the Treasury’s buyback scale is far smaller than the Fed’s bond‑purchase programs, it could still have a stimulative effect on the economy. With inflation still unchecked, this raises questions about whether the Treasury and the Fed are pulling in opposite directions.

Sosnick expects Powell’s speech to be fairly brief, and many of the market’s pressing questions may go unanswered. This year’s meeting focuses on financial innovation, and Powell may completely avoid discussing the Treasury’s recent bond‑market interventions. For investors, the real risk of the speech may lie not only in what Powell says, but also in what he chooses not to say.

items.title: 習近平訪美倒數 川普突暗示制裁「中國銀行」
items.title_en: Countdown to Xi Jinping's US Visit, Trump Hints at Sanctioning "Chinese Banks"
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美中官員正為中國國家主席習近平下月訪問華盛頓進行準備之際，美國總統川普週四 (27 日) 再度升高對北京的施壓力道，暗示不排除制裁協助伊朗石油交易的中國銀行。
川普週四向媒體表示，他「可能會制裁中國銀行」，並稱自己不必事先宣布所有措施。美國財長貝森特本週稍早也警告，若中國銀行參與將伊朗石油轉化為資金、進而支持伊朗政府的金融體系，就可能成為美方制裁目標。
儘管白宮對中措辭轉趨強硬，美中雙方仍持續推進高層互動。川普表示，習主席將在幾週後訪美，顯示兩國並未因伊朗制裁問題中斷元首會晤的準備工作。
美國駐中國大使龐德偉週三在北京會見中國外交部長王毅等官員，討論習近平即將對華盛頓進行的國是訪問。中國外交部發布的會談內容也提到，雙方將為下一階段的重要高層互動做好準備。
清華大學戰略與安全研究中心博士後研究員 Jodie Wen 表示，目前除了貝森特的警告之外，美方尚未公布具體制裁措施，因此現階段更像是一項警告。
她認為，川普與習近平今年 5 月會晤後，美中關係已轉向「可控競爭」，有別於拜登政府將中國視為戰略對手的定位。
中國對美國針對伊朗祭出的次級制裁，目前反應相對克制。北京僅表示將採取一切必要措施維護自身權益，但沒有說明可能採取哪些行動。中國外交部被問及是否曾就伊朗問題與美方溝通時，也表示沒有相關資訊可以提供，但證實兩國正討論川普與習近平會晤事宜。
布魯金斯學會中國中心主任 Ryan Hass 認為，由於美方在宣布制裁前並未進行充分鋪陳，北京可能將相關威脅視為政治表態，而非準備立即對中國大型金融機構採取行動。
Hass 指出，貝森特先前曾反問，為何美國要摧毀全球金融體系，北京可能據此判斷，華府不會對中國主要金融機構下手。他預估，美中貿易休戰仍將維持，因為關係再度惡化對雙方都更不利。
亞洲集團中國區董事總經理 Han Shen Lin 表示，中國目前的法律機制也為企業提供一定調整空間。中國企業的海外銀行可以遵守美國規定，但在中國境內仍須以中國法律為優先，使北京得以在維護自身利益的同時，有限度地配合美國制裁要求。
paras_en: CNBC reported that as U.S. and Chinese officials prepare for Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington next month, U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 27th) again stepped up pressure on Beijing, hinting that he would not rule out sanctioning Chinese banks that help facilitate Iran's oil transactions.

Trump told the media on Thursday that he "might sanction Chinese banks" and said he does not have to announce every measure in advance. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen earlier this week also warned that Chinese banks that turn Iranian oil into cash and thereby support Iran's government could become targets of U.S. sanctions.

Even as the White House’s language toward China has grown tougher, high‑level contacts between the two sides continue. Trump said President Xi will visit the United States in a few weeks, indicating that the two countries have not halted preparations for a summit despite the Iran‑sanctions issue.

U.S. Ambassador to China R. Nicholas Burns met on Wednesday in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials to discuss Xi’s upcoming state visit to Washington. The Chinese foreign ministry’s statement on the talks also said the sides will prepare for the next stage of important senior‑level interactions.

Jodie Wen, a post‑doctoral researcher at Tsinghua University’s Center for Strategic and Security Studies, said that aside from Yellen’s warning, the United States has not yet announced any concrete sanction measures, so at this stage it is more of a warning.

She believes that after Trump’s May meeting with Xi, U.S.–China relations have shifted to a "managed competition" model, different from the Biden administration’s view of China as a strategic adversary.

China’s response to the U.S. secondary sanctions on Iran has been relatively restrained. Beijing said it would take all necessary measures to protect its own interests but did not specify what actions might be taken. When asked if it had communicated with the U.S. on the Iran issue, the Chinese foreign ministry said it had no relevant information to share, but confirmed that the two countries are discussing the Trump‑Xi meeting.

Ryan Hass, director of the Brookings Institution’s China Center, said that because the U.S. has not laid out a full narrative before announcing sanctions, Beijing may view the threat as a political statement rather than an imminent move against its large financial institutions.

Hass noted that Yellen had previously asked why the United States would want to destroy the global financial system, and Beijing might infer from that that Washington will not target China’s major banks. He predicts the U.S.–China trade truce will hold, as a further deterioration would hurt both sides.

Han Shen Lin, managing director for Asia at a major Chinese conglomerate, said China’s legal framework gives companies some leeway. Overseas Chinese banks can comply with U.S. rules, but within China they must prioritize Chinese law, allowing Beijing to protect its interests while only partially accommodating U.S. sanction demands.

items.title: 美國號召G20寬鬆監管AI 馬斯克、黃仁勳、奧特曼將出席
items.title_en: US Calls for G20 to Adopt Looser AI Regulation, Musk, Jensen Huang and Altman to Attend
paras: 路透社引述消息人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳與OpenAI 執行長奧特曼預定下周出席在美國北卡羅來納州羅利舉行、聚焦科技議題的二十國集團（G20）部長級會議。
白宮科技顧問克拉茨歐斯（MichaelKratsios）的發言人表示，美國也安排SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克、Meta平台(META-US) 總裁麥考米克（DinaPowell McCormick），以及創投家兼前白宮AI顧問塞克斯（David Sacks），透過視訊連線向與會人士發表演說。據悉，相關演說將於9月1日登場。
一名白宮官員表示，美國將力促 G20 成員國簽署一項不具約束力的協議，主張以較寬鬆的方式監管 AI。該協議將呼籲各國避免成立新的監管機構，並與民間企業合作測試新興技術。
克拉茨歐斯在聲明中表示：「我們期待就更明智的監管方式、降低AI應用門檻，以及強化勞動力發展計畫進行深入討論，這些措施將推動全球經濟繁榮。」
OpenAI發言人表示，奧特曼將與美國商務部長盧特尼克進行爐邊對談，討論 AI 技術即將迎來的發展。黃仁勳的發言人則拒絕評論其出席安排。
此次會議是未來數月一系列 G20 相關會議之一，為今年 12 月在邁阿密舉行的 G20 領袖峰會預作準備。今年 G20 由美國擔任主席國。根據活動網站，成員國的科技與商務官員將在羅利會議上討論「AI 與其他新興科技」。
paras_en: Reuters, citing sources, reported that NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are scheduled to attend next week’s G20 ministerial meeting in Raleigh, North Carolina, which will focus on technology issues.

A spokesperson for White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios said the United States has also arranged for SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk, Meta Platforms (META-US) President Dina Powell McCormick, and venture capitalist and former White House AI adviser David Sacks to deliver remarks via video link, with the speeches slated for September 1.

A White House official said the United States will push G20 members to sign a non‑binding agreement advocating a more relaxed approach to AI regulation, urging countries to avoid creating new regulatory bodies and to work with private firms to test emerging technologies.

Kratos said in the statement, “We look forward to in‑depth discussions on smarter regulation, lowering the barriers to AI adoption, and strengthening workforce development programs, measures that will drive global economic prosperity.”

An OpenAI spokesperson said Altman will have a fireside chat with U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo to discuss the imminent developments in AI technology, while Huang’s spokesperson declined to comment on his attendance plans.

The meeting is one of a series of G20‑related gatherings in the coming months, preparing for the G20 Leaders’ Summit in Miami this December. The United States chairs this year’s G20, and according to the event website, technology and commerce officials from member states will discuss “AI and other emerging technologies” at the Raleigh meeting.

items.title: 西藏尼泊爾邊境山洪 90名美國人失聯 川普回應
items.title_en: Tibetan-Nepal Border Flash Flood Leaves 90 Americans Missing, Trump Responds
paras: 美國總統川普27日（周四）表示，尼泊爾爆發山洪，已有數十名美國人失聯，美國已向尼泊爾提供援助。
當天當被問及尼泊爾山洪以及失聯美國人的情況時，川普說：「非常糟糕，我方已經聯繫尼泊爾，提供了他們需要的一切幫助。你知道，我國和尼泊爾關係很好，這場山洪極其殘酷。」
他說道：「沒人見過這樣的景象，那些堅固結實、建造精良的建築物如同牙籤一般被沖毀。」
川普稱，大約有50至60名美國人失聯，但他尚未收到完整失聯人員名單。當天美國國務院通報，有90名美國人失聯。
據尼泊爾警方消息，尼泊爾北部地區山洪已造成至少389人死亡。
據《CNN》27日報導，在1,300多名失聯人員名單中，包含來自二十多個國家的700多名外國公民。馬來西亞外交部表示，55名本國公民下落不明；烏克蘭外交部稱，仍有至少56名烏克蘭人失聯；加拿大外長阿南德表示，目前至少有30名加拿大公民及永久居民下落不明；澳洲政府稱，至少39名澳洲人失聯。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday, the 27th, that a flash flood has erupted in Nepal, leaving dozens of Americans missing, and that the United States has provided assistance to Nepal.

When asked about the Nepal flash flood and the missing Americans, Trump said, "It's terrible, we have already contacted Nepal and offered them all the help they need. You know, our relationship with Nepal is very good, and this flood is extremely brutal."
He added, "No one has ever seen anything like this; those solid, well‑built structures were swept away like toothpicks."
Trump claimed that roughly 50 to 60 Americans are missing, though he has not received a complete list of the missing. The U.S. State Department reported that 90 Americans were missing that day.
According to Nepalese police, the flash flood in the northern part of the country has already caused at least 389 deaths.

CNN reported on the 27th that among more than 1,300 missing persons, there are over 700 foreign nationals from more than twenty countries. Malaysia’s foreign ministry said 55 of its citizens are unaccounted for; Ukraine’s foreign ministry said at least 56 Ukrainians remain missing; Canada’s foreign minister Anand said at least 30 Canadian citizens and permanent residents are missing; and the Australian government said at least 39 Australians are missing.

items.title: 美國防部封殺Anthropic踢鐵板 法院裁定「違法」
items.title_en: U.S. Defense Department Blacklists Anthropic, Court Rules It Illegal
paras: 美國加州聯邦法院週四 (27 日) 裁定，五角大廈將人工智慧公司 Anthropic 列為國家安全供應鏈風險，不僅侵犯其言論自由，也違反正當法律程序，因此判定這項決定「違法」。
美國聯邦地區法院法官 Rita Lin 撤銷 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險認定，並要求美國國防部收回所有針對該公司發布的指引、命令、通知及相關通訊。
Lin 在長達 59 頁的裁決中指出，五角大廈的決定「違法且毫無根據」。她表示，川普政府不能僅以國家安全為由，懲罰或報復批評政府政策的企業；憲法及國防部援引的聯邦法規，也不允許政府主要因 Anthropic 批評其 AI 使用政策，便對公司施加廣泛限制。
這場爭議源於 Anthropic 與國防部對 Claude 軍事用途的分歧。
Anthropic 拒絕允許美軍將 Claude 用於監控美國民眾或自主武器，主張現有 AI 模型的可靠程度仍不足以安全投入自主武器，國內監控也可能侵害民眾權利。
國防部則認為，私人企業不應限制軍方如何運用 AI。雙方協商破裂後，國防部今年 3 月將 Anthropic 列為供應鏈風險，禁止國防承包商在執行五角大廈業務時使用該公司的技術。
這是美國政府首次依據一項原本用於防範外國勢力滲透或破壞軍事系統的採購法規，公開將一家美國企業列為供應鏈風險。Anthropic 高層先前表示，這項認定可能造成公司數十億美元的業務損失，並損害其市場聲譽。
Anthropic 隨後於 3 月 9 日提起訴訟，指控國防長赫格塞斯越權，並因公司公開表達對戰場 AI 安全的看法而進行報復。公司也主張，政府在作出認定前，並未給予其提出異議的機會。
司法部則辯稱，這項認定源於 Anthropic 拒絕接受新的合約條款，而非公司對 AI 安全的立場。政府表示，Anthropic 對 Claude 設下使用限制，可能讓五角大廈無法確定軍方可如何運用該模型，並增加軍事行動期間系統遭停用的風險。
Anthropic 對此裁決表示欣慰。公司發言人聲明提到，Anthropic 將繼續與政府合作，運用 AI 強化美國國家安全，讓所有美國人都能從這項技術中受益。
不過，這項裁決尚未完全終結雙方的法律爭端。
Anthropic 仍在華盛頓特區進行另一宗相關訴訟，挑戰五角大廈依據不同法源作出的另一項供應鏈風險認定。若該項認定成立，Anthropic 仍可能遭排除於政府民用部門合約之外。
paras_en: A federal court in California ruled on Thursday (the 27th) that the Pentagon’s designation of artificial‑intelligence company Anthropic as a national‑security supply‑chain risk infringes its free‑speech rights and violates due process, deeming the decision illegal.

U.S. District Judge Rita Lin overturned Anthropic’s supply‑chain risk designation and ordered the Department of Defense to withdraw all guidance, orders, notices and related communications issued against the company.

In a 59‑page opinion, Lin said the Pentagon’s action was “illegal and baseless.” She noted that the Trump administration could not punish or retaliate against companies that criticize government policy on the grounds of national security, and that neither the Constitution nor the federal statutes cited by the DoD permit the government to impose sweeping restrictions simply because Anthropic criticized its AI‑use policies.
The dispute stems from a disagreement between Anthropic and the Defense Department over the military use of Anthropic’s Claude model.

Anthropic refused to allow the U.S. military to use Claude for domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons, arguing that current AI models are not reliable enough for safe deployment in autonomous weapons and that domestic monitoring could violate citizens’ rights.

The Defense Department countered that private firms should not limit how the military employs AI. After negotiations broke down, the Pentagon listed Anthropic as a supply‑chain risk in March, barring defense contractors from using its technology on Pentagon projects.

This marks the first time the U.S. government has publicly designated a domestic company as a supply‑chain risk under a procurement rule originally intended to guard against foreign infiltration or sabotage of military systems. Anthropic’s executives warned that the designation could cost the company billions of dollars in business and damage its reputation.

Anthropic filed a lawsuit on March 9, accusing Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin of overstepping his authority and retaliating for the company’s public statements on battlefield‑AI safety. The firm also argued that it was not given an opportunity to contest the designation before it was made.

The Justice Department argued that the designation resulted from Anthropic’s refusal to accept new contract terms, not from its stance on AI safety. The government said Anthropic’s usage restrictions on Claude made it difficult for the Pentagon to determine how the military could employ the model and increased the risk of the system being shut down during operations.

Anthropic welcomed the ruling. A company spokesperson said Anthropic will continue to work with the government to use AI to strengthen U.S. national security and ensure that all Americans benefit from the technology.
However, the decision does not fully resolve the legal battle between the parties.

Anthropic is also pursuing a separate lawsuit in Washington, D.C., challenging another supply‑chain risk designation the Pentagon made under a different legal authority. If that designation is upheld, Anthropic could still be excluded from civilian‑government contracts.

items.title: 「股神」巴菲特週日迎96歲生日 加碼Alphabet、擴大庫藏股仍難追上大盤
items.title_en: "Oracle of Omaha" Buffett Turns 96 on Sunday, Boosts Alphabet Stake and Expands Share Buybacks Yet Still Lags the Market
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，「股神」巴菲特即將在本週日 (30日) 迎接96歲生日，雖然他今年初卸下波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 執行長職務，但並未淡出公司決策，仍以董事長身分主導股票投資與庫藏股計畫。不過，波克夏今年股價幾乎原地踏步，明顯落後標普500指數13%的漲幅，成為交棒後最受關注的問題。波
卸任執行長後仍深度參與決策
巴菲特掌舵波克夏60年後，今年初將執行長職務交給阿貝爾 (Greg Abel)。過去8個月來，他仍每天前往奧馬哈辦公室、密切追蹤金融市場，並將工作重心放在自己最熟悉的投資與資本配置。
阿貝爾則負責管理波克夏旗下數十個營運部門，包括BNSF鐵路與大型電力事業。
CFRA分析師Cathy Seifert認為，巴菲特為阿貝爾留下穩健的公司基礎，兩人的能力也具有互補性。
不過，巴菲特今年年中曾摔斷腿，視力也持續惡化，已難以閱讀，顯示他的工作步調正逐漸放緩。
主導加碼Alphabet與擴大庫藏股
巴菲特卸任後最受矚目的投資，是波克夏持有的Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 部位。這筆投資始於2025年第三季，目前規模已增至350億美元，其中包括今年6月直接向Alphabet購入的100億美元股票。
Alphabet目前與可口可樂 (KO-US) 並列波克夏第三大股票投資，僅次於蘋果 (AAPL-US) 和美國運通 (AXP-US)。不過，波克夏最近一次加碼前，Alphabet股價已在16個月內上漲一倍，最新購入的100億美元部位目前略有虧損。
巴菲特也與阿貝爾共同決定擴大庫藏股。波克夏4月初至7月底買回近80億美元自家股票，成為公司歷來最積極的買回時期之一，遠高於第一季約2億美元。
以波克夏約1.1兆美元市值及股票流動性估算，公司每年有能力買回500億美元以上股票，相當於約5%市值。市場接下來將觀察，公司第三季是否繼續加速買回。
波克夏股價落後大盤
波克夏 (BRK.B-US) 週四小跌0.24%，收在503.70美元，今年以來股價僅小漲 1.38%，公司市值約1.08兆美元，股價較52週高點537.74美元低約6.3%，但仍較52週低點464.01美元高約8.6%。
儘管巴菲特仍積極參與決策，波克夏股價今年以來大致持平，A股約報75.3萬美元，B股約503美元；同期標普500指數累計上漲13%。波克夏的表現也落後保險、工業、鐵路和公用事業等相關類股。
股價落後的確切原因尚不明確。部分投資人可能仍在觀察阿貝爾接任後的表現，也可能對公司未更積極運用龐大現金感到失望。截至第二季末，波克夏持有3650億美元現金，且公司仍拒絕發放股息。
現金龐大但大型收購難尋
波克夏第二季買進230億美元股票，7月完成85億美元收購房屋建商Taylor Morrison，並於今年稍早斥資約20億美元投資日本保險公司東京海上。相關交易雖然降低部分現金部位，但波克夏每年稅後營業利益接近500億美元，現金仍會持續累積。
巴菲特一直希望完成規模可能達1000億美元以上的「大象級收購」，但波克夏堅持價格紀律，也不參與企業競標，使大型交易始終難以成形。聯合太平洋鐵路2025年7月同意收購諾福克南方後，波克夏也未進一步追求收購CSX。
投資團隊縮編引發接班疑問
波克夏投資團隊的安排同樣受到市場關注。長期投資經理Todd Combs去年12月轉往摩根大通後，巴菲特與阿貝爾並未補充人手。
目前Ted Weschler約管理波克夏超過3500億美元股票投資組合中的6%，整體投資組合則由阿貝爾監督。阿貝爾今年似乎尚未買進任何股票，反而出售約150億美元持股，包括原先由Combs管理的Visa (V-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)。
巴菲特約15年前延攬Weschler與Combs時，原先設想兩人未來共同管理整體投資組合，但之後似乎改變了安排。阿貝爾目前的做法也顯示，波克夏未來可能不再像巴菲特時代一樣，高度倚賴股票投資創造額外價值。
安排捐出持股但未告別投資
巴菲特上個月表示，計劃在2034年前捐出自己持有的全部波克夏股票。這筆約占公司13%的持股價值超過1400億美元，他希望三名逐漸年長的子女能在未來8年內親自完成捐贈。
即使已卸下執行長職務、著手安排捐出持股，巴菲特仍未離開股票市場。從1942年首次買進股票至今已過84年，他依然參與波克夏的重要投資與資本配置決策。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that "Oracle of Omaha" Warren Buffett will celebrate his 96th birthday this Sunday (the 30th). Although he stepped down as chief executive of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) earlier this year, he has not withdrawn from corporate decision‑making and continues to lead stock investing and the share‑repurchase program as chairman. Yet Berkshire’s stock has been essentially flat this year, lagging the S&P 500’s 13% gain and becoming the most watched issue since the leadership hand‑off.
After stepping down as CEO, Buffett remains deeply involved in decisions

After steering Berkshire for six decades, Buffett handed the CEO role to Greg Abel at the start of the year. Over the past eight months he still goes to the Omaha office daily, closely monitors the financial markets, and focuses his effort on the investments and capital allocation he knows best.
Abel is responsible for managing Berkshire’s dozens of operating subsidiaries, including BNSF Railway and large‑scale power businesses.
CFRA analyst Cathy Seifert says Buffett has left a solid corporate foundation for Abel, and the two executives have complementary strengths.
However, Buffett suffered a broken leg in mid‑year and his vision continues to deteriorate, making reading difficult and indicating his work pace is slowing.
He leads the increased stake in Alphabet and the expanded share‑buyback

The most closely watched investment since Buffett’s CEO exit is Berkshire’s holding in Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). The stake, initiated in the third quarter of 2025, has grown to $35 billion, including a $10 billion purchase directly from Alphabet in June this year.

Alphabet now ties with Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) as Berkshire’s third‑largest stock holding, behind Apple (AAPL‑US) and American Express (AXP‑US). Yet before the latest addition, Alphabet’s share price had already doubled over the prior 16 months, and the newly bought $10 billion position is presently slightly underwater.

Buffett and Abel also agreed to expand the share‑repurchase program. From early April to the end of July Berkshire bought back nearly $8 billion of its own stock, marking one of the most aggressive buyback periods in the company’s history, far exceeding the roughly $200 million repurchased in the first quarter.

Based on Berkshire’s roughly $1.1 trillion market value and stock liquidity, the firm can repurchase more than $50 billion of shares each year, about 5% of its market cap. The market will watch whether the company accelerates buybacks in the third quarter.
Berkshire’s stock lags the market

Berkshire (BRK.B‑US) slipped 0.24% on Thursday to close at $503.70, up just 1.38% year‑to‑date. The company’s market value is about $1.08 trillion; the price is roughly 6.3% below its 52‑week high of $537.74 but about 8.6% above its 52‑week low of $464.01.

Even though Buffett remains active in decision‑making, Berkshire’s stock has been essentially flat this year, with class A shares around $75,300 and class B at $503; over the same period the S&P 500 has risen 13%. Berkshire’s performance also trails related sectors such as insurance, industrials, railroads and utilities.

The exact cause of the lag is unclear. Some investors may still be watching Abel’s performance after the hand‑off, while others may be disappointed that the firm has not deployed its massive cash more aggressively. As of the end of the second quarter Berkshire held $365 billion in cash and still refuses to pay a dividend.
Huge cash but few large acquisitions

In the second quarter Berkshire bought $23 billion of its own stock, completed an $8.5 billion acquisition of home‑builder Taylor Morrison in July, and earlier in the year invested about $2 billion in Japan’s insurer Tokio Marine. While those deals trimmed cash, Berkshire’s after‑tax operating earnings are near $50 billion annually, so cash will keep accumulating.

Buffett has long hoped to execute a “mega‑elephant” acquisition that could exceed $100 billion, but Berkshire’s strict price discipline and avoidance of competitive bidding have kept such deals from materialising. After Union Pacific agreed in July 2025 to buy Norfolk Southern, Berkshire did not pursue a bid for CSX.
Investment team cuts raise succession questions
The composition of Berkshire’s investment team also draws market attention. After long‑term manager Todd Combs moved to JPMorgan in December, Buffett and Abel have not filled the vacancy.

Currently Ted Weschler oversees about 6% of Berkshire’s more than $350 billion of equity holdings, with the overall portfolio supervised by Abel. Abel appears to have bought no new stocks this year, instead selling roughly $15 billion of holdings, including Visa (V‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) that were previously managed by Combs.

When Buffett recruited Weschler and Combs about 15 years ago, the original plan was for the two to jointly manage the entire portfolio, but that arrangement seems to have changed. Abel’s current approach also suggests Berkshire may no longer rely on stock investing to generate extra value to the extent it did under Buffett’s era.
Arranging to donate holdings without exiting investing

Last month Buffett said he plans to donate all of his Berkshire shares before 2034. The stake, about 13% of the company and valued at over $140 billion, is intended to be given by his three aging children over the next eight years.

Even after stepping down as CEO and arranging the eventual donation of his stake, Buffett has not left the stock market. From his first purchase in 1942 to today, 84 years later, he still participates in Berkshire’s key investment and capital‑allocation decisions.

items.title: 輝達財報會議透露SpaceX三大訊號
items.title_en: Nvidia Earnings Call Reveals Three SpaceX Signals
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，投資人聆聽輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)財報電話會議，也從中獲得了一些有關SpaceX(SPCX-US)的資訊，足以推升這家由馬斯克(Elon Musk)執掌的火箭與AI公司股價。
輝達周三公布優於預期的財報及強勁財測後，股價周四(27日)上漲8.7%。這也帶動那斯達克綜合指數上漲1.6%。SpaceX股價上漲0.9%，收於140.87美元。標普500指數與道瓊工業平均指數分別上漲0.7%及0.2%。
SpaceX在輝達的財報電話會議中被提及。財務長Colette Kress表示，「我們預期每一家主要超大規模雲端服務商、新型雲端服務商、AI實驗室及系統OEM廠商都將部署Vera，目前已開始向包括甲骨文、SpaceX AI在內的主要合作夥伴出貨，而亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services)也將從本季開始收到出貨。」
Vera是輝達更新版的資料中心CPU，專注於改善AI代理工作負載，也就是處理超越單純在聊天機器人輸入提示詞的AI工作。
Kress補充，SpaceX最近收購的Cursor，年度經常性收入(ARR)已達到10億美元。這是華爾街最喜歡用來描述AI銷售成長的指標之一。以目前的業務規模來看，Cursor的年營收將超過10億美元。當然，ARR理應持續成長。根據報導，Anthropic的ARR最近已達650億美元。
另外，Kress也提到SpaceX的AI模型Grok。她表示，「輝達支援領先的閉源模型，包括OpenAI、Anthropic、Grok、Meta、Gemini，以及領先的開源模型，包括TML、Mistral、Qwen、Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Minimax及Nemotron。」
作為領先的AI模型固然很好，但隨著AI持續發展，市場也持續出現新的模型。閉源模型是在供應商的伺服器上透過雲端存取，客製化程度有限。開源模型則可以部署在任何伺服器上，有助於提升資料隱私，且可以完全客製化。
輝達財報對包括SpaceX在內的整個市場都相當重要。該公司晶片推動了AI運算熱潮，而SpaceX正試圖將這股熱潮轉化為價值數兆美元的業務。
SpaceX在2025年的AI營收為32億美元。根據華爾街預估，這項數字到2027年可能突破600億美元。
對輝達有利的事情，最終也有利於SpaceX。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that investors listening to Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings call also gleaned information about SpaceX (SPCX-US), enough to boost the stock of Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company.

After Nvidia posted better‑than‑expected earnings and strong guidance on Wednesday, its shares rose 8.7% on Thursday the 27th, lifting the Nasdaq Composite 1.6%. SpaceX shares rose 0.9% to $140.87. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.7% and 0.2% respectively.

SpaceX was mentioned during Nvidia’s earnings call. CFO Colette Kress said, “We expect every major hyperscale cloud provider, next‑gen cloud provider, AI lab and system OEM to deploy Vera; shipments have already begun to key partners including Oracle, SpaceX AI, and Amazon Web Services will start receiving shipments this quarter.”
Vera is Nvidia’s next‑generation data‑center CPU, focused on improving AI‑agent workloads – AI tasks that go beyond simple prompt‑based chatbot inputs.

Kress added that SpaceX’s recent acquisition, Cursor, now has annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $1 billion, a metric Wall Street loves for measuring AI sales growth. At its current scale, Cursor’s annual revenue will exceed $1 billion and ARR should keep growing. By comparison, Anthropic’s ARR has recently reached $65 billion.

She also referenced SpaceX’s AI model Grok, stating, “Nvidia supports leading closed‑source models including OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, Meta, Gemini, as well as leading open‑source models such as TML, Mistral, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Minimax and Nemotron.”

While leading AI models are valuable, the market continuously sees new models as AI evolves. Closed‑source models run on vendor servers accessed via the cloud and offer limited customization. Open‑source models can be deployed on any server, enhancing data privacy and allowing full customization.

Nvidia’s earnings are highly significant for the broader market, including SpaceX. Its chips have driven the AI computing boom, and SpaceX is trying to turn that momentum into a multi‑trillion‑dollar business.
SpaceX’s AI revenue is projected at $3.2 billion for 2025, and Wall Street estimates it could exceed $60 billion by 2027.
Things that benefit Nvidia ultimately also benefit SpaceX.
